Now the slide was clean and Lily could slide down too. They both had so much fun sliding and playing together. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max loved to nap in the warm sun. One day, Max saw a big cat napping in his spot. Max felt jealous. He wanted his spot back.

Max went to the cat and said, "Please, can I have my spot back?" The cat looked at Max and said, "No, I like this spot." Max felt sad, but he went to find a new place to nap.

In his new spot, Max felt an itch. He tried to scratch it, but it was hard. Max thought about the cat in his old spot. He thought the cat might be itchy too. Max went back to the cat and said, "I can help you if you have an itch." The cat smiled and said, "Thank you, Max." They both napped in the sun, happy and itch-free.

Cindy was a three year old girl who loved playing in the garden. One day she ran out of the house and opened the gate. She was so excited to explore, and started looking around.

Suddenly, Cindy noticed a wheat field. She thought it looked like a magical place, so she ran inside. She gasped as she saw a big, beautiful sunflower. 

"I wish I could freeze this moment forever," she said aloud. 

Just then, Cindy heard a voice. "No, that's not easy. It takes a lot of work to grow wheat," the voice said. 

Cindy turned and saw a farmer standing in the field. She didn't understand what the farmer meant, so she just smiled and said, "I still wish I could freeze this moment."

The farmer looked at Cindy kindly and with a twinkle in his eye, said, "Perhaps you can, but it takes effort. You need to plant the wheat, water it and look after it. With some work, you'll be able to enjoy this moment for a long time."

So Cindy started to work on the field, and soon she was able to enjoy the beautiful wheat field she'd discovered. She felt proud of her efforts and happy that she'd been able to freeze a moment in time that she could enjoy for a very long time.

Once upon a time there were two brothers named Billy and Joe. They both loved to explore the outdoors and always looked for adventure. One afternoon, they decided to take a walk in the woods.

Suddenly, something strange happenned. A glowing ball of light started to appear and floated above the trees. Billy and Joe were so amazed!

"We must catch it!" yelled Billy.

But each time the boys tried to get close to the ball, it would vanish! No matter how persistent they were, they were unable to catch it. 

Eventually, they had to give up. Joe said, "Let's go home now, brother. We'll come back another day and search some more." 

Billy and Joe happily returned home that morning, with an exciting secret to share.

Once upon a time, there was a big house full of bright colors. Mommy and Daddy hung pictures of rainbows and puppies on the walls.

Mommy said, "Let's make the house stay clean!"

Dad smiled and said "Yes! Let's do it!" 

They put away the toys, vacuumed the carpets, and washed the windows. Then, Mommy and Daddy hung up a new white curtain. 

Mommy said, "Now our house looks nice and clean!"

Dad smiled and said, "Yes it does! Now let's find pretty pictures to hang!"

Mommy and Daddy hung pictures of sunny landscapes, crystal waterfalls and bunch of colorful butterflies. 

Mommy said, "We did it! Our house is so bright and clean!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun. One day, she found a small seed in a place near her house. She dug a hole in the ground and put the seed inside. She watered it every day and waited patiently for it to grow.

After a few weeks, she saw a tiny plant growing from the ground. She was so happy and excited! Every day, she would check on it and make sure it had enough water and sunshine. The plant continued to grow taller and taller until it was as tall as Lily.

Lily was amazed at how the plant could fit in such a small place and still grow so big. She loved taking care of it and watching it grow. And every day, she would tell her friends about her amazing plant that grew in the small place near her house.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she went on an adventure with her best friend, Teddy the bear. They went on a walk in the forest, and Lily asked Teddy if he wanted to search for treasure.

Teddy was very intelligent and knew just where to look. They walked through the trees and over the rocks until they found a shiny diamond. Lily was so happy, and she thanked Teddy for being so smart. But then, they heard a loud noise coming from behind them.

It was a big, scary dragon! Teddy knew they had to run away fast. They ran and ran until they were safe at home. Lily hugged Teddy and said, "You're my hero, Teddy. You're so intelligent and you saved us from the dragon." Teddy smiled and hugged her back, happy to have helped his best friend.

Once upon a time, there was a loyal dog. He loved to help his owners, a family of four. Every day the dog would twist his body around them to show his love.

One day, the family decided to have a picnic. All the family members brought something to the picnic and the dog brought a bone. They all laughed and enjoyed themselves but the dog wished he had brought something nicer.

So, the day after the picnic, the dog went to the store. He looked around and found a bottle of wine. It was a nice, twisty shape and it looked delicious. The dog quickly bought the bottle and carried it back to the family picnic.

The family was so surprised and happy when the dog brought them the bottle of wine. Their loyal dog had gone all the way to the store to bring them a special surprise! They filled their glasses with the delicious wine and toasted their loyal dog.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly dog named Spot. Spot was very eager to do something special for his family. One day, he had an idea. He wanted to deliver a big surprise.

So, Spot started running. He ran and he ran until he saw a red wagon. Spot jumped in and began pulling it very fast.

As he went, Spot saw a tree with lots of apples. So he picked some and put them in the wagon.

Spot continued running and soon he saw a lake with some fish. So he quickly grabbed some and put them in the wagon too.

Finally, Spot arrived home. He was very excited! His family cheered and thanked Spot.

"Thank you Spot!" they said. "You delivered a wonderful surprise!"

Timmy wanted to go to the park but his mom said he had to stay at home. Timmy was very sad. Soon, he had an idea. He saw his dad's keys and he took them. Then he opened the door and went outside.

He walked to the park and he saw a police officer. The officer said, "Why do you have the keys?" Timmy was scared. The officer said, "You can't go to the park. You must come to jail with me."

Timmy did not want to go to jail so he ran away. He ran and ran until he felt tired. He couldn't run anymore. Soon, the officer caught him and he took Timmy to the jail. 

The officer put Timmy in a small room. He said, "You have to stay here until your mom is ready to get you." Timmy was very scared. He didn't like being in jail. 

Finally, the officer said he could leave. Timmy's mom came to get him and they went back home. Timmy was glad to be home and he promised himself he would never do anything bad again.

Once upon a time there was a fierce year. During this year, Andy faced many problems. He was feeling very worried and did not know what to do. 

Andy walked up to his mom and said, "Mom, I have so many problems. How can I solve them?" His mom smiled and said, "Andy, don't worry. You can solve any problem if you try your best."

Andy replied, "But, mom, some of the problems seem so big and fierce. How can I solve them?" His mom said, "If you break the problems down into small pieces, you can solve each piece one at a time. I believe in you!"

Andy smiled and said, "OK, mom. I'll try my best to solve these problems." He took a deep breath, gathered his courage, and started working. 

Each day he worked harder, and eventually he was able to solve all of the problems. He was so proud of himself! 

At the end of the fierce year, Andy realized that with hard work and determination, he could solve anything.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. She was three years old and excited about studying.

One day she was playing with a bubble. She watched it closely and studied how it floated in the air, wide and round. "This bubble is so pretty," she said.

Suddenly, the bubble floated away. The girl ran after it to try and catch it. It was so wide and she couldn't catch up. Suddenly the wind picked up and the bubble flew away.

The little girl was sad and started to cry. But then, she saw a rainbow in the sky. She smiled and studied it closely. She thought she could reach the rainbow if she flew on the back of a bird.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to the mall with her mommy to buy new toys and clothes. One day, they went to the mall and Lily saw a big toy she wanted. But her mommy said they couldn't buy it because it was too expensive.

Lily was sad and started to cry. Other people in the mall saw her crying and she felt embarrassed. Her mommy tried to calm her down but it didn't work. Suddenly, Lily had an idea. She asked her mommy if they could save money so they could buy the toy later. Her mommy agreed and they left the mall.

Over the next few weeks, Lily helped her mommy save money by not buying candy and toys. Finally, they had enough money to buy the toy Lily wanted. She was so happy and her smile increased as she played with her new toy. From then on, Lily learned that saving money was important and it made her feel proud.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play with blocks and make towers. One day, they have a task. Their teacher says they have to make a big tower with all the blocks. They are happy and start to work.

But Tom is not happy. He is angry and bored. He does not want to make a tower. He wants to break the towers. He waits for Anna and Ben to look away. Then he runs and pushes their tower. It falls down and makes a loud noise.

"Tom, stop!" Anna says. "You are bad. You prevent us from doing our task. Go away!"

But Tom does not listen. He laughs and runs to another tower. He pushes it too. It falls down and makes another loud noise.

"Tom, stop!" Ben says. "You are mean. You prevent us from having fun. Go away!"

But Tom does not listen. He laughs and runs to the last tower. He pushes it hard. But he is not lucky. The tower is too big and heavy. It falls on him and makes him fall too. He cries and says "Ow!"

Anna and Ben run to him. They are not angry anymore. They are sorry. They help him get up and hug him.

"Tom, are you okay?" Anna says. "We are sorry you are hurt. Do you want to play with us?"

"Yes, please," Tom says. "I am sorry I was bad. I was jealous of your towers. Can we make one together?"

"Of course," Ben says. "We are friends. We can share and help each other. Come on, let's make the biggest tower ever!"

They smile and hug again. Then they go to the blocks and start to build. Their teacher is proud of them. She says they are good and smart. They are happy and have fun.

Once there was a boy who loved to point. He would point to everything he saw. He had a mom who was very patient with him.

One day, he pointed to a big wall. His mom said it was called a pattern. He was so excited to learn the new word. He started pointing to different patterns, like the stripes and circles on his mom's shirt.

His mom's patience made him learn new and exciting things. He kept pointing to new patterns everywhere he looked and learned a lot that day. He liked to point and was very happy that his mom was so patient and taught him new things.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a cat named Zigzag. Zigzag loved to eat tasty food. One day, Zigzag saw a big, tasty cake on a table. It was so pretty and smelled so good.

Zigzag wanted the cake, but there was a little dog named Spot guarding it. Spot said, "This is my cake! You can't have it!" Zigzag knew he had to fight Spot to get the cake.

Zigzag and Spot fought for the cake. They ran around the room, chasing each other. Finally, Zigzag jumped high and grabbed the cake with his paws. Spot was sad, but Zigzag said, "We can share the cake, Spot!"

Spot and Zigzag ate the tasty cake together. They became good friends and promised to share all their food from then on. And they lived happily ever after.

Once there was a clumsy bear and a fast fox. They didn't like each other and always wanted to fight. Every day, the fox would run around the forest trying to catch the bear. But the bear was too clumsy and always managed to stay away.

One day, the bear had an idea. He asked the fox, "Let's settle this fight without fighting. Let's race to that big tree over there." The fox liked the idea and they both agreed.

The bear was slow and the fox was fast, but the bear was clever. When he got to the tree, he pretended to be tired and out of breath. The fox thought he had won and stopped running, but he was too late - the bear had already reached the tree first!

The fox was very angry but the bear was happy. He had won the race and settled the fight. From then on, the fox and bear were friends and never fought again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat oatmeal for breakfast every day. One morning, her mom made her oatmeal with some yummy fruits on top. Lily loved it so much that she asked her mom to make it every day.

Once upon a time there was a clumsy boy. He lived next to a deep, dark well. He was always curious and one day he decided to come closer to the well to take a peek inside. His dad was very worried and told him: "Don't come close to the well! You can hurt yourself!â€ But the boy ignored him and came closer. Suddenly, he lost balance and fell inside the well. 

The boy leaned against the walls of the well and started to cry. Then he heard a voice from above: â€œDo not worry! I am here to help youâ€. He looked up and saw a beautiful angel right above the well. The angel asked: â€œDo you remember what your dad said? If you do as your dad tells you, you can prevent yourself from getting into dangerous situations." 

The angel flew away, while the boy felt really grateful. He decided that he would always listen to what his dad said. From that day on, he would never be clumsy around the well again!

One day, two friends named Jack and Jill went on a walk. Jack had a big bag of candy in his pocket. Jill wanted some candy, but Jack wanted to trade for something else. Jill thought it was a difficult decision, so she walked away and ignored Jack's offer.

Jack was sad that Jill didn't want to trade with him. He thought of all the fun things they could have done with the candy, like make a delicious treat. But Jill was still ignoring him, so he shouted, "Hey Jill, why are you ignoring me?"

Jill looked back and said, "Trading candy is too difficult for me. I just don't want to think about it right now." Jack was disappointed, but he understood why Jill didn't want to trade. He tried to cheer her up by offering her a big hug, and she smiled and said, "Let's just take a break and go for a walk again."

They had a great time on their walk, and Jack and Jill eventually forgot about their trade. They were best friends forever and would never ignore each other again.

Tim and Sam were best friends. They liked to play with their toys and run in the park. One day, Tim got a new toy. It was a big truck that made loud noises. Sam wanted to play with it too, but Tim said no. He said it was his toy and he did not want to share.

Sam felt sad and angry. He thought Tim was not a good friend. He saw Tim's puppy sleeping on the grass. He had an idea. He took a stick and poked the puppy. The puppy woke up and barked. It was scared and hurt. Tim heard the noise and ran to his puppy. He saw Sam with the stick. He was very mad. He yelled at Sam and pushed him. He said Sam was a bad boy and he did not want to be his friend anymore.

Sam ran away crying. He felt sorry for what he did. He knew he was wrong. He wanted to say sorry to Tim and his puppy. He waited for a long time. He hoped Tim would come and talk to him. But Tim did not come. He stayed with his puppy and his truck. He was still mad.

Then, Sam saw something. It was a big dog. It was not a friendly dog. It was a dangerous dog. It had sharp teeth and angry eyes. It saw Tim and his puppy. It wanted to hurt them. Sam was scared. He wanted to help Tim and his puppy. He forgot about the truck and the stick. He ran to Tim and shouted. He told him to run away. He threw a rock at the big dog. The big dog growled and chased Sam.

Tim saw the big dog. He saw Sam trying to save him and his puppy. He felt sorry for what he said. He realized Sam was a good friend. He grabbed his puppy and his truck. He ran to Sam. He helped him get away from the big dog. They ran to a safe place. They hugged each other. They said sorry to each other. They forgave each other. They were happy again. They learned to share and to be kind. They played with the truck and the puppy. They were best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a prince who was very brave and kind. One day, he left his kingdom to go on an adventure. As the prince walked in the light of day, he heard a voice that said â€œHello!â€

The prince looked around, but he didnâ€™t see anyone. Then he saw a small fairy peeking out from behind a tree. The prince was very surprised!

â€œWhat is your name?â€ asked the prince.

â€œMy name is Glimmer,â€ said the fairy. â€œWill you play with me?â€

Once upon a time, there was a big jungle with many animals. There was a lion, a monkey, a zebra, and many more. One day, the lion saw a beautiful butterfly with many colors. The lion wanted to catch the butterfly, but the butterfly was too fast and flew away. The lion was sad, but the monkey told him not to worry. The monkey said that there were many other animals in the jungle, and they could play together. 

The lion and the monkey went to find the zebra. The zebra was running wild and having fun. The lion and the monkey joined in and they all played together. The lion forgot about the butterfly and was happy to be with his friends. They ran and played until it was time to go home. The lion went to sleep with a smile on his face, dreaming of his wild adventures with his friends.

Timmy was out playing in the park. He was feeling incredible and having so much fun. Suddenly, a boy next him said, "Hey Timmy, want some beef?"

Timmy hesitated for a moment. He wasn't sure if he wanted beef or not. He wanted to try it, but he was a bit scared. Finally, he said, "Yes please."

The boy gave Timmy a big piece of beef. Timmy took a bite and it tasted absolutely delicious. But, he started to feel a bit funny afterwards. His stomach started to feel a bit weird.

Timmy felt regret for trying the beef. He ran to his mom and told her what happened. His mom said, "It's alright Timmy. Next time, just wait a while before you try something new."

Timmy nodded and promised he would never eat anything too quickly again. From then on, he was always very careful with anything that he tried.

Tom and Mia are playing in the park. They like to pretend they are superheroes. Tom has a stick. He says it is his weapon. Mia has a scarf. She says it is her cape.

"Look, I can fly!" Mia says. She runs and jumps with her scarf. Tom follows her. He swings his stick. He says he is fighting bad guys.

"Be careful, Tom!" Mia says. "Don't hit anyone with your weapon. You have to behave."

"I know, I know," Tom says. "But I have to save the world!"

They see a big dog. The dog is barking. It has a collar and a leash. But no one is holding the leash. The dog is loose.

"Uh-oh," Mia says. "That dog is scary. Maybe it is a bad guy."

"Or maybe it is a friend," Tom says. "Let's go and see."

They walk towards the dog. The dog sees them. It stops barking. It wags its tail. It looks happy.

"Hi, doggy," Mia says. She holds out her hand. The dog sniffs it. Then it licks it.

"See, it is a friend," Tom says. He puts down his stick. He pets the dog.

The dog likes them. It follows them. They play together.

A man comes. He is looking for the dog. He sees the leash on the ground. He sees the kids and the dog.

"Hey, there you are!" he says. He picks up the leash. He thanks the kids. He says they are very nice.

"You have a good dog," Mia says.

"He is a good dog, but he sometimes runs away," the man says. "He likes to explore. But he can be dangerous. He could get hurt or hurt someone else. He has to behave."

He puts the leash on the dog. He says goodbye to the kids. He walks away with the dog.

The kids wave to the dog. They are sad. They liked the dog.

"Maybe we can see him again," Tom says.

"Maybe," Mia says. "But we have to be careful. He is not our dog. He has an owner. And he has to behave."

They go back to their game. They pick up their weapon and their cape. They are superheroes again. They have fun. They behave.

Tom and Anna were brother and sister. They liked to play outside, but they did not like winter. Winter was cold and wet and gray. They wanted summer to come back, with sun and flowers and ice cream.

One day, their mom said, "Let's go to the park and have some fun. Winter can be fun too, if you accept it and look for the good things."

Tom and Anna did not want to go, but they followed their mom. At the park, they saw a big hill with snow. Their mom gave them a sled and said, "Try it, it's fun to slide down the hill."

Tom and Anna were scared, but they decided to try. They sat on the sled and pushed off. They went fast and felt the wind on their faces. They laughed and screamed and felt happy. They went up and down the hill many times, until they were tired and cold.

Their mom said, "Let's go home and have some hot chocolate. You did great, you accepted winter and had fun. Sometimes, you have to try new things and see the good in them."

Tom and Anna agreed. They hugged their mom and said, "Thank you, mom. You are right, winter can be fun too. We learned something new today."

The moral value of the story is: Accepting what you cannot change and finding the good in it can make you happier and wiser.

Lily and Tom were twins. They liked to play with their toys. One day, they went to the store with Mom. Mom said they could each pick one toy.

Lily saw a small doll with a pink dress. She liked it very much. She took it from the shelf and hugged it. Tom saw a big truck with lights and sounds. He liked it very much. He took it from the shelf and pushed it.

"Look, Mom, I want this doll!" Lily said.

"Look, Mom, I want this truck!" Tom said.

Mom looked at the toys. She said they were too expensive. She said they could only get one toy to share.

Lily and Tom did not like that. They both wanted their own toy. They started to cry and scream. They pulled the toy from each other. They made a lot of noise and motion.

Mom was very angry. She said they were being naughty and greedy. She said they could not have any toy at all. She took the toys from them and put them back on the shelf. She said they had to go home.

Lily and Tom were very sad and sorry. They had no toy and no fun. They wished they had been nice and quiet. They learned a hard lesson. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a toy car that he loved to use to play with his friends. One day, Timmy went to the park to play with his car, but he realized that his car was missing! Timmy started to cry because he loved his toy car so much. 

Suddenly, a man came up to Timmy and asked him why he was crying. Timmy told the man that his toy car was gone. The man told Timmy that he saw a thief take it. Timmy was very sad because he didn't know what to do. 

But then, Timmy had an idea. He asked his friends if they wanted to play a game to find the thief and get his toy car back. They all agreed and started to look for the thief. They were very competitive and wanted to win the game. After a few minutes, they found the thief and got Timmy's toy car back! Timmy was so happy that he could use his toy car again.

Once upon a time, there lived a very pretty little girl. Every day, she would take her scooter around the city and explore new places.

One day, she came across an injured bird. She quickly brought some food and water to the bird, hoping it would help to heal it. Then, she placed the bird into a cozy basket and waited until dark.

Suddenly, the bird flew out of the basket. The little girl was so happy to see it fly away. She sat under a tree and watched the bird in the night sky.

The next day, the little girl came back to the spot. She was relieved to find that the bird had healed and was flying around again. She wanted to do something special for the bird, so she brought a new pair of shoes for it. They were so pretty and sparkly!

The little girl was very happy. She always enjoyed making things better. She felt a great sense of accomplishment for having healed the bird and giving it a new pair of shoes. From then on, she continued to explore the city with her scooter, looking for opportunities to heal and help.

Once upon a time, there was a green bird. She flew over the trees and down to the ground. The bird wanted to find a special person to help her.

She flew until she saw a building. She saw a sign that said "veterinarian". She had no idea what that meant, but she wanted to find out.

The bird passed through the door and there was a lady inside. The bird hop-hopped up to the lady, who smiled at her. The lady said she was the veterinarian and she could help her. The bird was happy, and the veterinarian took her to a special room.

The veterinarian took out a bright light and looked at the bird's feet. She said the bird was healthy and she passed the test. The bird thanked the veterinarian, and the veterinarian said she could go back and fly.

The bird flapped her wings, and it felt so good. She flew high into the sky, a happy green bird.

Once upon a time, there was a bright little girl. She loved to play. One day, she found a large rug. She thought it would be perfect for playing. 

So she ran to get her friends. When they saw the rug, they were very excited. They all wanted to play a game. 

The first game was hide-and-seek. The little girl closed her eyes, and the others ran and hid. When she opened her eyes, the rug was empty! 

After a few minutes, the little girl found one of her friends behind the rug. Then she found another, and another. Finally, everyone was found and they had lots of fun. 

The little girl and her friends played games like this all day long. They laughed and cheered when they found each other. They had a bright, wonderful day.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to mix different colors of paint together. He would mix blue and yellow to make green, and red and blue to make purple. One day, Timmy's mom asked him to help her hang up some clothes on the hanger. Timmy was happy to help, and he hung up all the clothes neatly.

As Timmy and his mom were hanging up the clothes, their nosy neighbor, Mrs. Johnson, came over. "What are you two doing?" she asked. "We're hanging up clothes," Timmy replied. "Oh, I see," said Mrs. Johnson, looking around. "What a nice mix of colors you have on those hangers!"

Timmy smiled proudly, knowing that he had helped his mom and made a nice mix of colors on the hangers. Mrs. Johnson smiled too, and went back to her own house. Timmy and his mom finished hanging up the clothes, and Timmy went back to his paint mixing, happy to have helped his mom and shown off his skills to their nosy neighbor.

Lily and Tom were playing in the park. They saw a man with a cane. He walked very slowly and looked sad.

"Hello, sir," Lily said. "Do you want to play with us?"

The man smiled. "Thank you, little girl, but I can't play. My leg hurts and I need this cane to help me."

Tom had an idea. He ran to the sandbox and grabbed some sand and sticks. He started to build something.

"What are you building, Tom?" Lily asked.

"I'm building a new cane for the man. Maybe it will make him happy," Tom said.

He worked hard and made a cane out of sand and sticks. He put a flower on top. He brought it to the man.

"Here, sir, this is for you. A new cane. It has a flower, too," Tom said.

The man was surprised. He took the cane and held it gently.

"Wow, this is amazing. You are very kind, little boy. Thank you so much," the man said.

He tried to stand up with the cane, but it broke. The sand and sticks fell to the ground.

"Oh, no, I'm sorry. It was not strong enough," Tom said.

The man laughed. "Don't worry, it's okay. It was a beautiful gesture. You made my day. I'm very grateful to you and your friend," the man said.

He hugged Tom and Lily. They hugged him back.

They all smiled and felt happy.

Little Peter enjoyed playing games with his friends. One of his favourites was 'match'. He would try to find two objects of the same shape or colour and put them together.

One day, Peter had a nightmare in which he was in a room filled with objects and he had to match them all but he was too little to do it. In the nightmare, the room seemed to keep on getting bigger and bigger.

When he awoke, it was morning and he was relieved that it was just a dream. He decided to enjoy his favourite game of 'match' with his friends instead. 

So Peter and his friends went outside and played 'match'. They had a lovely time until it was time to go home. Peter was glad to be playing a game so much more fun than his little nightmare.

Once upon a time, there was a boy called Tom. Tom was three years old and he was very interested in learning new things. One day, Tom's mum brought home an attractive dictionary. Tom was so excited! He wanted to release the dictionary from its cover and find out what wonderful words and pictures it held inside.

Tom opened the dictionary and looked through its pages. He couldn't believe his eyes. It was full of colourful pictures and lots of new words. Tom was so happy he ran around the house.

Tom's mum smiled. She gave him a hug and helped him to use the dictionary. Together they read some words and looked at lots of pictures.

Tom was very pleased with his new dictionary. From then on he was always keen to release it and learn new things.

Once upon a time, there was a long snake named Sam. Sam was very sad because he could not find a friend who would accept him. He tried to play with the other animals, but they were all scared of him.

One day, Sam found a glove on the ground. It was a big glove, just the right size for him. Sam had an idea. He put his long body inside the glove and wore it like a costume.

Now, the other animals were not scared of Sam anymore. They saw the glove and thought it was a funny costume. They started to play with Sam and accept him as their friend. Sam was very happy because he finally found friends who liked him.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy. He was looking for something to pick. He saw a jet in the deep sky. The little boy wanted to pick the jet. He felt so happy.

He jumped up and grabbed the jet. He started to fly around in the sky. The little boy was so excited. He made big deep circles in the sky.

Suddenly, the little boy heard a loud noise. He looked down and saw a big truck. The truck was so big and strong. The truck had to pick up the jet.

The little boy was sad that he had to let go of the jet. He waved goodbye as the truck drove away with the jet in the back. The little boy watched until he couldn't see the jet anymore.

The little boy was sad, but he knew the jet would be happy with the truck. He smiled and went back home. He had a wonderful time and would never forget it!

Billy was feeling gloomy. He stood outside and looked up at the sky. Suddenly he jumped as he heard a noise!

"What was that?" he asked.

"It's just the water jumping up the drain," his mom said.

Billy smiled. He loved to jump! He jumped up and down the street, higher and higher each time. His mom laughed and said, "Look at you go!" Billy beamed with pride.

The sun began to shine and the gloom disappeared. Billy jumped one last time, up into the air and down onto the ground. His mom clapped and hugged him tight.

"You sure do like to jump!" she said.

"Yes!" Billy said with a grin. "Jumping is fun!"

Once there was a deaf girl who liked to have fun. On every holiday, she liked to fold just about everything she saw. She folded all of her blankets, her pillows, her stuffed animals and even her clothes! 

One day, she went on a vacation with her family. On the airplane, she was bored so she started to fold the napkins and tissues they gave her. When she saw the people around her, she even tried folding their newspapers and books. 

When they arrived at their destination, the little girl thought it was the perfect time to have some more fun. She found lots of things to fold, like her mom's towel, her dad's hat and even her brother's shoes! Then, she kept making fun folding shapes, like animals, birds and drums.

Finally, it was time to go back home. On the flight, the girl was not as bored as before. So, instead of folding, she just watched all the people around her. She was so amazed how everybody was talking, it almost felt like a special holiday for the deaf girl!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a large backyard with lots of flowers and trees. One day, Lily's neighbor came over to say hello.

"Hi Lily, I love your big backyard. It's so pretty!" said the neighbor.

"Thank you," replied Lily. "I value my backyard a lot. I like to play and explore here every day."

The neighbor smiled and said, "That's wonderful, Lily. I have a big backyard too, but it's not as pretty as yours. Maybe you can teach me how to make mine look nice too?"

Lily was happy to help her neighbor and they spent the afternoon planting flowers and picking berries. From that day on, they became good friends and enjoyed spending time together in each other's backyards.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to watch the birds in her backyard. One day, her daddy asked her if she wanted to help him grill some burgers. Lily was excited to help.

As they were grilling, Lily noticed her daddy had a thoughtful expression on his face. "What are you thinking about, Daddy?" she asked.

"I'm just thinking about how lucky we are to have each other and this yummy food to eat," her daddy replied.

Lily smiled and watched the burgers sizzle on the grill. She couldn't wait to try one. When they were done, she took a big bite and exclaimed, "This is the best burger ever!" Her daddy smiled and gave her a big hug. They enjoyed their meal together, watching the birds fly by.

Once upon a time there was a family. They wanted to have dinner so they looked at the menu. It had lots of different kinds of food. The mom wanted to try something new, so she chose one of the special things on the menu. The dad wanted something normal so he chose something he could recognize.

When their meals arrived, the mom and dad were excited to eat. But when they tasted their food, they were even more excited. It was delicious! They were able to complete their meal and were really happy they tried something new. 

After they finished their meals, they decided to get something else on the menu. The mom went with something special again and the dad chose something normal. They were both happy with their choices and completed their meal with a smile. 

The family was so glad they looked at the menu. They had a wonderful dinner and were full and happy.

Lily liked to play with her dolls. She had many dolls, but her favorite was Anna. Anna had a pink dress and a yellow hat. Lily liked to dress Anna and comb her hair.

One day, Lily and her mom went to the park. Lily brought Anna with her. She saw a big slide and wanted to go on it. She asked her mom if she could go. Her mom said yes, but told her to hold Anna tight.

Lily climbed up the stairs and sat on the slide. She held Anna tight. She slid down fast and laughed. She liked the slide. She wanted to go again.

But when she got up, she saw a stranger. The stranger was a boy. He had a blue shirt and a green cap. He was holding Anna. He had taken Anna from Lily.

Lily was scared and angry. She ran to the boy and shouted, "Give me Anna! She is mine! You are a bad stranger!"

The boy looked at Lily and said, "No, she is mine! I like her! She is pretty!"

He tried to run away with Anna, but Lily was faster. She caught up with him and grabbed Anna. She pulled hard and got Anna back.

The boy cried and said, "That is not fair! You are mean!"

Lily hugged Anna and said, "No, you are mean! You took Anna from me! She does not fit you! She fits me!"

She ran to her mom and told her what happened. Her mom was proud of Lily. She said, "You are brave, Lily. You did the right thing. Anna is yours. You love her and take care of her. The stranger was wrong. He should not take things that are not his."

Lily smiled and said, "Thank you, mom. I love you and Anna. Can we go on the slide again?"

Her mom said, "Yes, we can. But be careful and watch out for strangers."

Lily nodded and said, "I will, mom. I will hold Anna tight."

They went on the slide again and had fun. Lily and Anna were happy.

Lily and Tom were best friends. They liked to play in the park every day. They had a secret spot under a big tree, where they kept their toys and books.

One day, it was very dark and rainy. Lily and Tom wanted to go to the park, but their moms said no. They said it was too wet and cold. Lily and Tom were sad. They missed their secret spot.

"Let's make a promise," Lily said to Tom on the phone. "When the sun comes back, we will go to the park and have fun."

"OK, I promise," Tom said. "I care about you, Lily. You are my best friend."

"I care about you, too, Tom. You are my best friend," Lily said.

They smiled and said goodbye.

The next day, the sun came back. It was bright and warm. Lily and Tom ran to the park. They found their secret spot under the big tree. They hugged and laughed. They played with their toys and books. They were happy.

They kept their promise. They cared about each other. They were best friends.

John was just a little boy and he loved to explore. He had heard about a distant island, so he decided to find it. He studied maps and asked grown-ups until he found out where it was.

John packed his things and set off on a boat. After a few days of sailing, he arrived on the island. It was beautiful and full of amazing things to do. John was very excited.

He spent days exploring the island. He found interesting plants and animals, and even made new friends. He was very happy.

The island was also independent. It didn't have a ruler and the people lived in harmony. Everyone looked after each other and cared for their environment. It was a place where John could grow and learn new things.

So, John decided to live on the island. He made a house there and grew a garden. His new friends helped him to learn more about the island and eventually he felt like he belonged.

John had found his own special island and he was happy.

Once upon a time, a little birdie named Tweetie was playing on the ground. Tweetie had many friends who also liked to play on the ground. One day, a big birdie came to them and said, "The ground is dangerous. You should fly high up in the sky where it's safe."

Tweetie and his friends were scared because they had never flown before. They asked the big birdie, "How do we fly?" The big birdie replied, "You just flap your wings and you'll be able to fly."

Tweetie and his friends tried to flap their wings and they were surprised when they started to fly. They flew high up in the sky and realized that it was much safer up there. From then on, they spent their days flying and playing in the sky, and they never went back to the dangerous ground again.

Once upon a time, there was a small elf named Pixie. She was very good at solving problems. One day, Pixie saw something strange in the sky. She had never seen anything like it before.

Pixie looked closer and saw something moving in the light. "What is this?" she said out loud. She tried to make out what it was.

Suddenly, Pixie remembered that her friends had told her about something called motion. That was when things moved by themselves.

So Pixie decided to solve the mystery. She took out a magnifying glass and looked very carefully. After a long time of looking, Pixie finally saw what it was - a beautiful butterfly!

Pixie was so happy to have solved the mystery. She waved goodbye to the butterfly as it flew away, and smiled to herself.

Tom and Sam are brothers. They like to play with cars and trucks. They have a big toy truck that can make noises and move. They need fuel to make the truck go. Fuel is a liquid that comes from a can.

One day, they find a can of fuel in the garage. They think it is for their truck. They pour some fuel into the truck and turn it on. The truck makes a loud noise and smoke. Tom and Sam are happy. They drive the truck around the garage.

"Look, our truck is so fast and strong!" Tom says.

"Yes, it is the best truck ever!" Sam says.

They do not see their dad coming into the garage. He smells the fuel and sees the smoke. He is angry and scared. He runs to the truck and turns it off. He grabs Tom and Sam and takes them outside.

"What are you doing? This is not fuel for your truck! This is fuel for the lawn mower! It is dangerous! It can make fire and hurt you!" he yells.

Tom and Sam are sad and sorry. They did not know. They cry and hug their dad.

"I'm sorry, dad. We did not know. We just wanted to play with our truck." Tom says.

"Me too, dad. We did not mean to be bad." Sam says.

Their dad hugs them back. He is glad they are not hurt. He tells them to never touch the fuel again. He tells them to relax and calm down. He takes them inside to have some juice and cookies.

But when they go back to the garage, they see their truck is dead. The fuel has ruined it. It does not make noises or move anymore. It is broken and useless. Tom and Sam are very sad. They loved their truck. They wish they had not used the wrong fuel. They have no more fun with their truck. The end.

Once upon a time, there lived a tiny white rhinoceros. He was so small that he could fit in the palm of a grown up's hand. Everyone in the neighbourhood thought he was so cute and often wanted to pick him up and play with him.

One day, the rhinoceros was walking through a big whimsical forest, exploring and enjoying the sights. Suddenly, he heard a mysterious voice. 

"Shhhhrrrrrriiiiiiinnnnnkkkkk" said the voice.

But the rhinoceros was scared and he ran away. 

Much later, after conquering his fear, he returned to the forest and he heard the same mysterious voice again. 

"Shhhhhrrrrrriiiiiiinnnnnkkkkk" said the voice again.

This time, he was brave enough to follow the voice and he saw a small white door. He opened it and found himself in a secret world full of tiny animals and plants. The mystery voice had been coming from a friendly, magical wizard who shrank animals to the size of his tiny world. 
The rhinoceros was so excited that he stayed and had many fun adventures. He became best friends with the wizard and even agreed to be shrunk whenever the wizard wished. 

So every time the white rhinoceros wanted to explore the tiny magical world, he simply had to hear

Lily and Ben were best friends. They liked to play in the park and pretend they were superheroes. One day, they found a big black hat under a tree. It had a pointy top and a silver buckle.

"Wow, look at this hat!" Lily said. "It is so cool!"

"Can I try it on?" Ben asked.

"Sure, here you go," Lily said. She gave the hat to Ben and he put it on his head.

Suddenly, Ben felt a strange feeling. His eyes turned green and his nose grew long and crooked. He started to laugh in a wicked way.

"Ha ha ha! I am a witch now!" Ben said. "I can do magic and cast spells!"

Lily was scared. She did not like the new Ben. He did not look like her friend anymore. He looked mean and scary.

"Ben, take off the hat!" Lily said. "You are not a witch, you are my friend!"

"No, I like being a witch!" Ben said. "It is more fun than being a superhero! Watch this!" He waved his hand and a gust of wind blew Lily's hair.

"Stop it, Ben! That is not nice!" Lily said. She ran to Ben and tried to pull the hat off his head. But the hat was stuck. It did not want to come off.

"Help me, Lily!" Ben said. He did not like being a witch anymore. He wanted to be himself again.

Lily and Ben pulled and tugged at the hat. They worked together and finally the hat came off. Ben's eyes turned blue and his nose became normal. He smiled and hugged Lily.

"I am sorry, Lily," Ben said. "I was a bad witch. I did not mean to hurt you."

"It is okay, Ben," Lily said. "You are my friend. I forgive you."

They threw the hat away and ran to the swings. They decided to play superheroes again. They agreed that being a witch was not cool at all.

Once upon a time, there was a little penguin named Pip. Pip loved to waddle around and play with his penguin friends. One day, Pip decided to create a big snow fort. He worked and worked until the fort was as tall as he was! 

But then, a big polar bear came along and wanted to play too. Pip was anxious because he knew polar bears could be dangerous. The polar bear started to knock down the snow fort and Pip tried to stop him. 

But it was too late. The polar bear knocked down the fort and Pip was stuck underneath. Pip's friends tried to help him, but it was too late. Pip had been hurt and couldn't move. The friends were sad and didn't know what to do. And that's how the story of Pip the penguin ended.

Tommy was a young boy and he had just discovered a radio. He was very excited and wanted to try it out. He took it outside and looked at all the different buttons and knobs. Suddenly, he heard music coming out of the radio! He had never heard anything like it before and he was amazed. After playing with the radio for a while, he decided to show it to his friends. He took it to the playground and the children gathered around to see what the radio could do. They listened to all sorts of music coming from the radio and danced around together enjoying the new sound. Tommy was so proud of his discovery and his friends thought it was great too. Everyone had a wonderful time at the playground that day.

Ben and Lily were twins who liked to play with their toys. One day, they found a big box in the garage. It was heavy and had a label that said "Do not open". Ben and Lily were curious and wanted to see what was inside.

They pushed and pulled the box until they moved it to the living room. They used a scissors to cut the tape and opened the box. Inside, they saw a lot of shiny things that looked like stars. They were happy and started to take them out and play with them.

But the shiny things were not stars. They were fireworks that their dad had bought for a special night. The scissors made a spark when they cut the tape, and the spark lit one of the fireworks. The firework made a loud noise and flew out of the box. It hit the curtains and set them on fire.

Ben and Lily were scared and ran away. They heard more noises and saw more fire. They hid under the bed and cried. Their mom and dad came home and saw the smoke and the flames. They called the firemen and tried to put out the fire.

The firemen came and stopped the fire. They asked Ben and Lily what happened. Ben and Lily felt guilty and told them the truth. They said they were sorry and that they did not know the shiny things were dangerous. Their mom and dad were angry and sad. They gave Ben and Lily a big hug and said they were glad they were safe. But they also said they had to pay a lot of money to fix the house and the things that were burned. They said Ben and Lily had to give away some of their toys and do extra chores to help. Ben and Lily nodded and said they would. They wished they had never opened the box.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to fish with his dad. They would go to the lake and sit on the dock with their fishing poles. Timmy's dad would put a worm on the hook and they would wait for a fish to come.

One day, Timmy felt something tug on his line. He grabbed the fishing pole and started to reel it in. It was a big fish! Timmy was so excited. He showed his dad the fish and they took a picture together.

After they caught some more fish, they went home. Timmy's mom cooked the fish for dinner. It tasted normal, but Timmy was proud that he caught it himself. He couldn't wait to go fishing again with his dad.

Sam and Jane were best friends, who always had fun together. One day, they decided to have a picnic in the park. As they unpacked their food, they could not agree on what to use on their sandwiches.

"Let's use butter," said Jane.

"No," said Sam, "I want to use oil."

Jane thought that oil was too messy and argued, "No, butter is better!"

Sam disagreed. He thought oil was fair because it tasted delicious and was healthy too. In the end, they reached a compromise and used both butter and oil on their sandwiches.

So the two best friends had a very yummy picnic with their fair sandwich spread. They laughed and smiled, happy to disagree and still remain good friends.

Once upon a time, in a busy little town, there lived a girl named Sue. Sue loved to go for walks on the trail near her house. One sunny day, she decided to take her little brother, Tim, with her.

As they walked, they saw many animals, like birds, cats, and dogs. Tim was so excited! He asked Sue, "Can we come here every day?" Sue smiled and said, "I promise, we will come here as much as we can."

One day, while on the trail, they found a lost puppy. The puppy was sad and scared. Sue and Tim decided to help the puppy find its home. They asked people in the busy town if they knew the puppy. Finally, they found the puppy's owner, who was very happy to see it again.

From that day on, Sue and Tim were known as the best helpers in the busy little town. They kept their promise and continued to walk on the trail, always looking for ways to help others. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a big boat. It was shiny, very big and had lots of parts. There was a big window on the boat and a funny flag on the top. One day, the boat was ready to sail. Everyone was happy, but they were also a bit worried.

The boat went sailing away in the ocean. The waves were very big. The boat went up and down with all the waves. It made everyone a bit scared, but they all had brave smiles too.

While everyone was sailing, the captain looked out of the window. He was looking for something. Suddenly, he shouted with joy and said, "I found it! Look!"

Everyone was excited as they all looked in the same direction. There, in the far distance, they could see a small island.

Everyone on the boat cheered, and they sailed faster to get to the island. Finally, they arrived, and they all had a wonderful time together.  They were not worried anymore.

One day, a little girl named Sally was walking in the forest and came across a new hut. She was very excited because she had never seen such a thing. She excitedly ran to the hut and put her hand on it. She was just about to knock when she heard a voice from inside the hut saying â€˜Listenâ€™.

Sally was very surprised and scared. She couldnâ€™t see anyone inside the hut. She took a few steps back and asked, â€˜Who said that?â€™

Again, she heard the same voice saying â€˜Listenâ€™. This time, the voice was a little louder. Sally was still scared but she was also curious. She carefully took a few steps forward and listened carefully.

The voice said, â€˜Come inside. I have a surprise for you.â€™ Sally was excited and scared at the same time. She slowly opened the door and saw a little old lady inside the hut.

The old lady smiled and said, â€˜I have something special for you. Itâ€™s a new toy!â€™ Sally was so happy. She thanked the old lady and started playing with her new toy. She had a lot of fun and listened carefully to the old lady's stories.

Ben and Jen are twins. They live in a hut with their mom and dad. They have a dog, a cat and a hen. The dog is big and brown. The cat is small and black. The hen is white and lays eggs.

Every morning, Ben and Jen help their mom and dad. They feed the dog, the cat and the hen. They give them water and food. The dog likes bones. The cat likes milk. The hen likes corn. They are happy animals.

But one day, Ben and Jen are lazy. They do not want to feed the dog, the cat and the hen. They want to play with their toys. They say to their mom and dad, "We are tired. We do not want to feed the animals. You do it."

Their mom and dad are not happy. They say to Ben and Jen, "You are not tired. You are lazy. You have to feed the animals. They are hungry and thirsty. They need you. If you do not feed them, they will be sad and sick."

Ben and Jen feel bad. They do not want to make the animals sad and sick. They say to their mom and dad, "We are sorry. We will feed the animals. We love them." They go to the hut and get the water and food. They feed the dog, the cat and the hen. They pet them and talk to them. The animals are happy and healthy. Ben and Jen are happy and proud. They are not lazy. They are good twins.

Once upon a time there was a little boy called Tom. Tom loved fruit. He knew all the different kinds of fruit and he always ate lots.

One day Tom went to the fruit store. He wanted some apples because they were his favourite. He looked at the apples but all of them were dull. It made him very sad. 

He asked the shopkeeper, "Do you have any nice apples?" But the shopkeeper said, "Sorry, I only have dull apples today." Tom knew he would have to look for nice apples somewhere else.

Tom kept walking and soon he found another fruit store. When he got there he saw lots of colourful, juicy apples. He was so happy! He asked the shopkeeper, "Can I have three apples please?"

The shopkeeper said, "Yes, of course!" Tom knew he had found the perfect apples. He thanked the shopkeeper, paid for the apples and went home. 

Tom was so excited to have the delicious apples. He and his family all enjoyed them and they were so pleased he had been able to find nice apples. He was a very happy little boy.

Once upon a time there was a girl. She liked to climb trees and loved to play with her friends. One day, she decided to have a party. She asked her friends to come over and play.

At the party, everyone had fun climbing the trees. But then something bad happened. One of the kids fell from a tree and got hurt! All the kids were very scared.

The girl was very sad and worried. She wanted to help her friend but didn't know what to do. She asked her mom for help. Her mom called the doctor and soon the friend was feeling better.

But the bad thing was that none of the kids wanted to come back to the party ever again. The girl was very sad that her party was ruined. She learned a hard lesson that day and was careful when climbing trees with her friends.

Once upon a time, there was a delicate boat floating in the ocean. It was getting tired so it decided to take a rest. The boat gently floated to a beautiful harbor. The harbor was full of many boats like the delicate one. The delicate boat was happy to be in the harbor. All the boats rested in the harbor together. There was a nice breeze blowing. Everyone was happy and safe in the harbor. The delicate boat went to sleep in the harbor and felt cozy and content. 

The boats stayed in the harbor for a long time to get some rest. After a while, the boats started to wake up and were ready to sail again. The delicate boat was happy to be in the harbor and thanked them all for the peace it had found. 

The delicate boat was so happy that it had found a place to rest in the harbor. It said goodbye to the other boats and started sailing again. The delicate boat went on many adventures, but it would always remember the peaceful moments it had spent in the harbor.

Once upon a time, there was a big dog named Max. Max was very happy because he had a big bone to chew on. But then Max saw his friend, a little bird named Tweet, who was very sad. Max asked Tweet what was wrong, and Tweet said that she lost her True nest. Max felt bad for Tweet and wanted to help her find her nest. 

Max looked everywhere for Tweet's nest, but he couldn't find it. Max didn't want to spoil Tweet's day, so he kept looking. Suddenly, Max saw something impressive. It was a big tree with lots of branches. Max thought that Tweet's nest might be up there. So, Max climbed up the tree and found Tweet's nest on one of the branches. 

Tweet was very happy to see her nest again. She thanked Max and said that he was an impressive friend. Max felt happy that he could help his friend and that he didn't spoil her day. From that day on, Max and Tweet were True friends forever. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a garden with lots of fruit and vegetables. The little girl who lived in the garden was very polite. Every day, she picked the best looking tomatoes and cucumbers, and then she cooked them. She would mix them together, add a pinch of salt, and then stir the mixture.

The girl loved to eat what she made, and she always shared it with her friends who lived nearby. Sometimes they all cooked together, and they would each bring a different ingredient. One day, the girl's friend brought an inch of ginger root. It smelled delicious, and it tasted really good with the tomatoes and cucumbers.

So from then on, the polite little girl and her friends cooked together and enjoyed their delicious creations. The end.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Nora wanted to explore nature. She went to a meadow filled with white flowers, and she picked one that was the prettiest. She smelled it, and it was so sweet.

Then Nora saw a small bunny hopping in the grass. She giggled and smiled, and she softly called the bunny over to her. The bunny hopped closer and closer until it was right beside her. Nora was so happy, so she bent down and kissed the bunny on its nose.

The bunny was very happy, so it hopped off into the meadow and found it's family. Nora smiled and looked out into the meadow, taking in all the whiteness and beauty of nature. It was so gorgeous, like a picture from a fairy tale.

Nora kept playing until the sun started to go down. She thanked nature for this amazing day and kissed her hand and blew it towards the sky.  And with that, Nora went home and went to bed, dreaming of all the wonderful things nature had to offer.

The big blue sky was shining high up above. The sun was high and strong. 

Lily was sitting in her chair in her garden when she noticed that a bird was caught in the branches of the big tree. She went to help him. With both hands, she lifted the heavy branches and the bird flew out, chirping and singing.

Lily then went to the garden shed. She opened the door and there saw a lollipop. She quickly picked it up and put it in her pocket.

On the way back, it started to rain. The rain made Lily's hair and clothes wet.

Lily called out loudly "Mom! I'm wet!" Her mom came out and said: "Here, you can have this umbrella. Now, you won't get wet!"

Lily smiled. She put the lollipop in her mouth and lifted the umbrella. She laughed and started to run around in the rain.

Tim and Mia were playing in the backyard. They liked to pretend they were astronauts and explore the moon. They wore big helmets and boots and carried a flashlight.

"Look, Tim, I found a rock!" Mia said, holding up a shiny stone. "Maybe it is a moon rock!"

"Wow, let me see!" Tim said, running over to her. He took the rock and looked at it closely. "It is very pretty. But be careful, Mia. It might be hot."

"Why?" Mia asked, puzzled.

"Because some rocks come from the sky. They burn when they fall. They are called meteors." Tim explained.

"Really? How do you know?" Mia asked.

"I saw it in a book. Daddy read it to me. He said meteors are very rare and special." Tim said proudly.

"Can we keep it?" Mia asked.

"Sure, why not? It is our moon rock. But we have to put it in a safe place. Maybe in a box or a jar." Tim said.

"Okay, let's go find one." Mia said. They put the rock in Tim's helmet and ran to the house.

They did not see the smoke coming from the rock. They did not hear the hissing sound. They did not feel the heat. They did not know the rock was still burning. They did not know they had found a meteor.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. He loved gum. One day, he found a thin piece of gum on the ground. He thought it was very special. He put the gum in his pocket to save it for later.

Tom went to play with his friend, Sam. They played a game where they had to escape from a pretend monster. They ran and hid, but the monster always found them. Tom felt scared, but he remembered his special gum. He thought it could help them win the game.

Tom took out the thin gum and shared it with Sam. They both chewed the gum and started to run from the monster again. But this time, they did not escape. The gum made them feel sick and slow. The monster caught them, and they lost the game. Tom and Sam were very sad. They learned never to pick up gum from the ground again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved going to the festival with his mom and dad. They always got to eat delicious food and play fun games. 

One day, Timmy and his family were walking to the festival when Timmy saw a big tree. He wanted to climb it, but his mom said, "Be careful, Timmy. You might fall." 

At the festival, Timmy saw a big candy apple. It looked so delicious that he asked his dad if he could have one. His dad said, "Sure, Timmy. But be careful not to drop it." 

Later, Timmy was playing a game and he won a prize. He was so excited that he ran to show his mom. But he tripped and fell. His mom helped him up and said, "It's okay, Timmy. You're okay." 

Timmy learned that it's important to be careful and listen to his parents. And even if he falls, they will always be there to help him up.

Once upon a time there was a brave bear. He wanted to explore the world. He looked around, but all he saw was a cold landscape.

The bear was feeling a bit sad he didn't have anywhere to go. So he decided to make a request. He asked the wind to take him somewhere new.

The wind heard his request and became very excited. It picked up the bear and blew him all around the world. 

The bear got to see so many exciting places. He saw mountains and canyons, sandy beachs and icy glaciers. Every place he went was so different and exciting.

Finally, the wind brought him back home. The bear thanked the wind for his adventure and ran off into the cold landscape. He was so happy to be home.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved to do things. One day she had an idea. She decided to find a horn! She found one that was very shiny and she was so excited.

Next she found a person with a big truck. She asked the person if she could do something with the horn. The person was very polite and said yes. So she put the horn in her pocket and ran off.

She went to a playground where some children were playing. She saw a swing in the playground so she went over to it. She pulled the horn out of her pocket and blew it! The children stopped and stared at her in surprise!

The little girl smiled and said, "Let's all swing together!" Everyone was very polite and thanked her for making it so much fun. Together they all swung higher and higher until it was time to go home.

The little girl was very happy she had done something special with the horn and the children. She put the horn away and went off to bed, dreaming of the adventure she had.

Jack saw a modern safe sitting on the table. The safe was shiny and new. He was very curious.

Jack wanted to open the safe. He asked his mom if he could try, but she told him no. She said it was too hard for him.

Jack was sad. He started to ignore his mom and focus on the safe. He tried to figure out how to open it. Jack looked around for tools and found a big key.

Jack thought this was the key to the safe. He tried to use it but the safe didn't open. His mom told him that the key was too old and it wouldn't work.

Jack was frustrated. He looked around and asked his mom "What key should I use?"

Her mom smiled and said "No key. The safe is made to stay closed so your things are safe inside. It has a modern design that stays closed and only I can open it".

Jack looked at the safe with a new respect and accepted that he had to ignore it. He knew that even though he couldn't open it, his things inside were safe.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his baseball. His baseball was blue and he loved it very much. One day, Timmy went outside to play with his baseball. He threw it up in the air and it went far away. Timmy went to discover where the baseball went. He walked and walked until he found it in a bush. Timmy was happy to find his blue baseball and played with it all day long. The end.

Little Jack was walking in the park. He heard a voice and he wanted to find it. He looked around and saw a dog. The dog was running, so Jack started to rush too!

"Hello, dog!" shouted Jack.

The dog turned and barked.

"What is your name?" asked Jack.

The dog barked back, "My name is Rover!"

Suddenly, another dog came running up.

"Don't worry Jack," said Rover. "This is my friend Lucky. He is been a bit jealous because I was talking to you."

Jack laughed, "Jealous? That's silly!"

Rover and Lucky started running, and Jack followed them. The three of them rushed around the park having lots of fun together. They played together until Jack had to go home. He said goodbye to his new friends, and headed home with a smile on his face.

Once upon a time, there was a poor man who walked with a cane. He needed the cane to help him walk because his leg hurt. One day, his friend came to him and asked to borrow the cane. The poor man was kind and said yes, he could lend the cane to his friend. 

The friend used the cane for a little while and then brought it back to the poor man. The poor man was happy to have his cane back because he needed it to walk. 

Even though the poor man didn't have much, he was still happy to help his friend. He knew that sometimes people need help and it's important to be kind and lend a hand or a cane when you can.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to eat ice cream. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a teaspoon to eat his ice cream with. Timmy was very slow at eating his ice cream, but he enjoyed it very much.

After Timmy finished his ice cream, he went to play with his toys. But then, he accidentally knocked over a vase and it broke. Timmy was scared because he knew he did something wrong. He thought about lying and telling his mom that the vase broke on its own. But Timmy knew that lying was not good, so he told the truth and said he broke the vase.

Timmy's mom was proud of him for telling the truth, and she hugged him. She said it was okay and that accidents happen. From that day on, Timmy learned that it's always best to tell the truth and not to lie.

Steven was walking through the woods and he saw something gray on the ground. He went closer to take a look and saw a cute little fox with its head covered in a gray blanket. Steven said to the fox, "Hello!"

The fox looked up at Steven with wide eyes. It said, "Help me! I'm stuck!"

Steven knelt down so he could help the fox. He carefully moved the top away and saw that the fox had caught his tail in a prickly bush. Steven untangled the fox's tail and the fox thanked him.

The fox stood up and said, "Thank you for helping me. I am so glad that you covered me!"

Steven smiled and said, "You're welcome! It's nice to help friends." He waved goodbye as the fox ran back into the woods and disappeared in a flash of gray.

Once there was a little boy who wanted to go on adventures. His mommy bought him a scooter to help him get around. On the first day, he was a bit weak and struggled to manage the scooter. But, after some practice, he got better and better. He got so good that he scooted all around the park. Everywhere he went, he felt so adventurous. He explored all of the paths, trees and rocks.

When he got tired, he would rest for a bit. He knew that he had to manage his energy so he could keep having fun. And he did! He managed his energy perfectly so he could play all day. He even managed to show off to his friends and pretend he knew how to do all sorts of tricks.

He quickly became a pro at scootering around the park. He was so proud of himself and his mommy was very proud too. He smiled as he scootered around, knowing he had managed to get really good at it.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, Lily saw a big, beautiful rainbow in the sky. She ran to her mom and said, "Look, Mommy! A pretty rainbow!"

Her mom said, "Yes, Lily, it's very pretty. But we have to leave soon to go to the store."

Lily was sad to leave the rainbow, but she knew she could come back and see it another time. As they walked to the store, Lily saw some kids playing in the rain. She wanted to play too, but her mom said no. Lily felt ashamed that she couldn't play in the rain like the other kids.

When they got home, Lily's mom surprised her with a rainbow sticker. Lily was so happy and put it on her favorite toy. She said, "Thank you, Mommy! Even though we had to leave the rainbow, I have a little rainbow with me now."

Lily and Tom were friends who liked to play with loops. Loops were round things that you could roll, spin, or wear. They had many loops of different colors and sizes. One day, they received a big box from their aunt. Inside the box, there were many new loops that they had never seen before.

"Wow, look at these loops!" Lily said. "They are so shiny and pretty. Can we play with them?"

"Of course we can!" Tom said. "Let's see what they can do."

They opened the box and took out the loops. Some of the loops had bells, some had beads, some had ribbons, and some had lights. They tried to roll, spin, and wear the loops, but they did not work well. The bells made too much noise, the beads fell off, the ribbons got tangled, and the lights hurt their eyes.

"These loops are not fun," Lily said. "They are too different from our old loops. I want to play with our old loops."

"Me too," Tom said. "Let's put these loops back in the box and play with our old loops."

They put the new loops back in the box and went to look for their old loops. But they could not find them. They looked everywhere, but they were gone.

"Where are our old loops?" Lily asked. "Did someone take them?"

"Maybe the aunt took them," Tom said. "Maybe she wanted to trade them for the new loops."

"That's not fair!" Lily said. "We did not want to trade our old loops. We liked our old loops. They were our favorite loops."

They started to cry. They wished they had not opened the box. They wished they had not played with the new loops. They wished they had kept their old loops.

The moral of the story is: Be careful what you wish for. Sometimes, the things that seem new and exciting are not as good as the things that you already have. You should appreciate what you have and not be greedy for what you don't.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who had a red box. Inside the red box was a pair of scissors. She liked the scissors a lot. Every day, she would take them outside and sit in the grass and play with them.

The scissors grew very big in the grass. Soon they were bigger than the red box. Every day, the scissors grew and grew until they were big enough to use to cut the grass.

The little girl had so much fun playing with the scissors and cutting the grass. She liked the feeling of being tough and strong, like grown-ups.

The little girl learned a valuable lesson - when you work hard and grow, you can do amazing things.

One night, when Shani put on her pajamas, she said goodnight to her dad before going to bed. She was about to close her bedroom door when she heard a strange noise coming from her closet. Shani slowly opened the door and peered inside. A little squirrel was sitting in the corner, and he didn't look very scared.

"What are you doing in here?" Shani asked.

The squirrel chuckled and replied, "I'm just looking for a place to stay for the night." Shani thought the squirrel was harmless, so she slowly reached in and gently picked him up. She placed the squirrel in her bed and sat down next to him.

The squirrel continued to chatter away about his adventures, and Shani found the stories fascinating. When it was late and the squirrel had to go, he said goodbye to Shani and scampered off into the night. 

Before leaving, he smiled back at her and said, "Don't forget to keep your closet door open, you never know what might come to sleep in there." 

That night Shani went to bed, and sure enough, when she woke up the next morning, there was a nest of baby squirrels in her closet. She smiled, remembering the friendly and harmless squirrel who had warned her of the surprise guests.

Sam and Lily were bored. They had no toys to play with. Their mom said they had no money to buy new toys. She said they had to use their imagination.

Sam had an idea. He saw a big cardboard box in the garage. He dragged it to the living room. He said to Lily, "Let's make a fort with this box. We can cut a door and a window. We can draw pictures on it. We can pretend it is a castle or a spaceship or a cave."

Lily nodded. She liked Sam's idea. She helped him cut and draw on the box. They used scissors and crayons and tape. They made a fort with the cardboard box. They crawled inside and closed the door.

They played for a long time. They pretended they were kings and queens, astronauts and aliens, explorers and animals. They had fun with their cardboard fort. They forgot they had no toys.

Their mom came to see them. She smiled. She said, "You two are very creative. You made a wonderful fort with a cheap box. I'm proud of you. Do you want some cookies and milk?"

Sam and Lily nodded. They came out of their fort. They hugged their mom. They said, "Thank you, mom. We love you. We love our fort. Can we keep it?"

Their mom nodded. She said, "Of course you can. As long as you don't make a mess. Now, enjoy your cookies and milk. And keep using your imagination."

Mama was sitting on the porch, enjoying a mild day. She was sipping her drink when, suddenly, her three-year-old son ran out of the house. He had a smile on his face and a look of excitement in his eye.

"Mama, can I have a drink too?" he asked.

Mama smiled and nodded. She filled a cup with her drink and handed it to her son.

He took a sip and his face lit up. "Yum! This drink is so yummy!"

Mama's heart filled with love for her son. She gave him a big hug and kissed him on his head.

"I love you, my boy," she said.

He smiled and hugged her back. "I love you too, Mama."

Tom and Anna are playing in the sand. They have a big bucket and a small shovel. They want to make a sand castle.

"Look, Anna, I made a tower!" Tom says. He puts some sand in the bucket and flips it over. A sand tower comes out.

"Wow, Tom, that's a nice tower!" Anna says. She makes another tower next to Tom's. They make four towers in a row.

"Let's make a wall around our castle!" Tom says. He digs a trench with his shovel and piles up the sand.

"OK, Tom, let's do that!" Anna says. She helps him with the wall. They make it high and strong.

They are happy with their castle. They sit inside and pretend to be a king and a queen.

"Tom, I have an idea!" Anna says. "Let's bury something in the sand and see if we can find it later!"

"That sounds interesting, Anna!" Tom says. "What should we bury?"

"How about this shell?" Anna says. She picks up a shiny shell from the sand. "It's pretty and smooth."

"OK, Anna, let's bury the shell!" Tom says. He digs a hole with his shovel and puts the shell inside. He covers it with sand and smooths it over.

"Can you remember where we buried it, Tom?" Anna says.

"Yes, Anna, I can!" Tom says. He points to the spot. "It's right here, next to the wall!"

"Good, Tom, let's go play something else and come back later!" Anna says.

They leave their castle and their shell and go to play with a ball. They have fun in the sun. They forget about the shell for a while.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a tall tree. The tree was so high that it almost touched the sky. Many birds lived on this tree. Two little birds, named Tim and Kim, lived there too.

One day, Tim found a big, juicy worm. Kim saw it and said, "Can we share the worm, Tim?" Tim thought for a moment and said, "Yes, we can share it." So, they both ate the worm and felt very happy.

After that, Tim gave Kim a big wink. Kim winked back. They knew that sharing made them happy. From that day on, they always shared everything they found. All the other birds saw this and started to share too.

Soon, the whole tree was full of happy birds, all sharing and caring for each other. The tree became the happiest place in the town.

The moral of the story is that sharing makes everyone happy.

Tom and Lily like to play with their toys. Tom has a camera that can take pictures. Lily has a doll that can talk. They have fun together.

One day, Tom wants to take a picture of Lily's doll. He says, "Lily, can I see your doll? I want to take a picture of her."

Lily says, "No, Tom. She is my doll. You can't have her."

Tom says, "Please, Lily. Just for a minute. I will give her back to you."

Lily says, "No, Tom. Go away. Find your own toy."

Tom feels sad and angry. He says, "Fine, Lily. You are mean. I don't want to play with you anymore. I quit."

He takes his camera and runs away. He goes to the park and looks for something to take a picture of. He sees a bird, a flower, a dog, and a ball. He tries to take pictures of them, but his camera is weak. It does not work well. The pictures are blurry and dark. He can't see anything.

Tom cries. He misses Lily and her doll. He wishes he did not quit. He wants to say sorry and play with her again. He runs back to his house and looks for Lily. He finds her in her room. She is playing with her doll.

Tom says, "Lily, I am sorry. I was wrong. Can I play with you and your doll?"

Lily looks at Tom. She sees his camera and his tears. She feels sorry for him. She says, "It's okay, Tom. I am sorry too. I was selfish. You can play with me and my doll."

Tom smiles. He hugs Lily and her doll. He says, "Thank you, Lily. You are a good sister. Can I take a picture of you and your doll?"

Lily says, "Yes, Tom. You can. But first, let me help you with your camera. Maybe it needs new batteries. Then it will be strong and work well."

They go to the kitchen and find new batteries for the camera. They put them in and turn it on. The camera works well. It takes clear and bright pictures. They take pictures of each other and their toys. They have fun together. They are happy. They don't quit.

Mia was a chubby baby who loved to chew on everything. She chewed on her toys, her blanket, her fingers and even her hair. She liked to make loud noises with her mouth and teeth.
