One day, Mia saw a bottle on the table. It was shiny and red and had a funny shape. She crawled over to the bottle and grabbed it with her hands. She put the bottle in her mouth and tried to chew on it. But the bottle was hard and smooth and did not taste good. Mia made a face and spat out the bottle.

"Hey, that's my bottle!" said Ben, who was Mia's big brother. He ran over to the table and took the bottle from Mia. "You can't chew on that, it's not for babies. It's for blowing bubbles!"

Ben showed Mia how to blow bubbles with the bottle. He squeezed the bottle and made a lot of tiny bubbles come out. The bubbles were shiny and colorful and floated in the air. Mia clapped her hands and laughed. She wanted to blow bubbles too.

"Can I try?" she asked Ben.

"Okay, but be careful," said Ben. He gave the bottle back to Mia and helped her hold it. He told her to blow gently and not to chew. Mia followed his instructions and blew a big bubble. She was very happy and proud. She blew another bubble and another. She forgot about chewing and enjoyed the bubbles with Ben.

Once upon a time there was a humble girl who liked to paint. She wanted to go on an adventure, so she picked up her paintbrush and went to the forest. There, she found a small weapon with a bright handle. She thought it looked just like something an explorer would have. So she picked it up and painted a big â€˜Xâ€™ on it.

The girl was so happy to have her own weapon that she couldn't stop smiling. She ran around the forest coloring everything in sight with her paintbrush. She painted trees, rocks, and even a big log. She made the forest so pretty.

When she finished, the humble girl was so proud of her work. Before she left, she stood in the middle of the forest and twirled her weapon around as she smiled. She was so happy that she wanted to stay in the forest forever. But night was coming and she had to go home.

So with her weapon in one hand and her paintbrush in the other, she set off for home, looking forward to the next dayâ€™s adventure.

Once upon a time, there was an old man who was very hungry. He saw a campfire and decided to warm himself up. He stepped closer to the campfire and soon he was warm and toasty.

Suddenly, a gust of strong wind blew and the flames grew bigger. The old man backed away, but it was too late. His clothes had already caught on fire. He screamed for help but it was too late. He kept burning until he was all gone.

Everyone in the town had seen it and learnt a lesson from it. They learnt that they should be careful with things like fire. They knew that it was dangerous and never to be played with.

The old man's sight could still be seen by everyone as a reminder of what happened. He reminded them to be careful and never too trusting with their sight.

Once there was a girl named Sam. She was three years old and she loved playing dress-up. Every day she would go to her special trunk and wear something different.

Today, her favorite thing was her modest blue dress. It was her favorite color and very pretty. She put it on and twirled around in the mirror.

â€œLook at me, Mommy!â€ She said.

â€œYou look very nice,â€ mommy said. â€œBut I think you need to wear something else for your play date.â€

So, Sam dug deep into the trunk and found a hat with a pretty flower on it. She put it on and twirled around again.

â€œHow do I look?â€ She asked.

â€œYou look very beautiful,â€ mommy said, giving Sam a big hug.

Sam loved wearing her special clothes. It made her feel special and happy, like she was getting ready for the best life ever!

Mia and Leo are friends. They like to play with toys and eat snacks. One day, Mia has a peanut. She likes peanuts. They are crunchy and salty. Leo does not have a peanut. He wants a peanut. He is jealous of Mia.

"Can I have your peanut?" Leo asks Mia.

"No, it is mine. You have a cracker. Eat your cracker," Mia says.

"But I want a peanut. Please, Mia, give me your peanut," Leo begs.

"No, no, no. Go away, Leo. Leave me alone," Mia says. She puts the peanut in her mouth and chews.

Leo is sad and angry. He does not like Mia. He does not want to be her friend. He thinks Mia is mean and selfish. He runs away from Mia and cries.

Mia hears Leo cry. She feels sorry for Leo. She does not want to make him cry. She does not want to lose her friend. She spits out the peanut and runs after Leo.

"Leo, Leo, wait. I am sorry. I was mean. You can have my peanut. Here, take it," Mia says. She gives Leo the peanut.

Leo stops crying. He looks at Mia and the peanut. He smiles. He takes the peanut and says, "Thank you, Mia. You are a good friend. I am sorry, too. I was jealous. Can we share the peanut?"

Mia nods. She smiles, too. She says, "Yes, we can share the peanut. And we can share the cracker, too. And we can play with toys and eat snacks. We are friends, Leo."

Leo and Mia hug. They share the peanut and the cracker. They play with toys and eat snacks. They are happy. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who went to visit her grandma in the countryside. The girl was really excited to go to the countryside, because she has heard lots of stories about the beautiful flowers there. When she arrived, the little girl ran around and saw lots of different flowers in the garden of her grandma's house. She was so amazed by the beautiful flowers that she ran around slowly so that she can admire each and every one of them. 

Suddenly, the little girl stopped and saw a beautiful flower that no one else seemed to notice. It was a very small flower growing slowly in the grass. The little girl slowly reached out to pluck the flower, but her grandma suddenly said: "No sweetheart, don't pick the flower. It takes a very long time for it to grow and if you pick it, it won't be able to grow anymore." 

The little girl thought for a moment and then smiled. She told her grandma that if she let the flower grow, then it will be much bigger and brighter for her next visit. 

Moral of the story: Sometimes it is better to appreciate something and leave it be, because it may surprise you with its beauty later on.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to stand on her tiptoes and look out the window. One day, her mommy said she could go outside and play. Lily was so excited! She ran outside and saw her friends. They asked if she could play with them, and her mommy said it was okay. She was permitted to play with her friends. They played and laughed and had so much fun together. When it was time to go back inside, Lily was sad because she didn't want the fun to end. But she knew she could play with her friends again tomorrow. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a lab named Max. Max loved to play fetch with Timmy. One day, Timmy threw a stick for Max to fetch, but Max ran away and didn't come back. Timmy was sad and frustrated because he loved Max and didn't know where he went.

Timmy searched for Max all over the town. He asked his friends and neighbors if they had seen Max, but no one had. Timmy was so sad that he cried himself to sleep every night.

One day, Timmy's neighbor found Max in his backyard. Max had hurt his paw and needed to go to the vet. The neighbor took Max to the vet and Max's paw was healed. Timmy was so happy to have Max back and he hugged him tightly. From that day on, Timmy made sure to always keep Max safe and close to him.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to climb things. One day, he saw a big cliff and wanted to climb it. He climbed and climbed until he got to the top. But then, he accidentally slipped and fell down. He broke his arm and felt very frustrated. From that day on, Timmy learned to be more careful when climbing.

Johnny was tired. He sat on the floor, playing with his blocks. He built a tall tower and was proud to see it standing. He watched it sway back and forth and smiled. His sister Millie saw the tower too. She wanted her own blocks to do the same. Millie felt jealous.

Johnny smiled and said, "Do you want to play with my blocks Millie?" Millie's eyes lit up and she said, "Yes please". Johnny handed her his blocks and she started playing. 

Millie relaxed and forgot about her jealousy. She built a high tower too. Johnny watched and smiled. 

Millie asked, "Do you feel better now Johnny?" Johnny nodded and said, "Yes I do". Millie smiled and the two continued building their towers.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She had a new rug in her room. It was pink and soft. One day, Lily wanted to pick up her toys, but she saw that her rug was dirty. She asked her mom to help her clean it. They used soap and water to make it clean and new again. Lily was happy because her rug looked pretty again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Cindy. Every day, Cindy would go to the store to get milk for her family. She loved the store and was always greeted by the friendly shopkeeper.

One day when Cindy was at the store, she noticed something strange: the shelves were all empty! She asked the shopkeeper why the shelves were empty. "It's too hard for you to understand," the shopkeeper said.

Cindy wasn't happy about this. But she had to trust the shopkeeper. So, she said goodbye and went home.

When Cindy told her family the news they didn't recognize the problem. But then they noticed something even more strange: the milk was gone too!

The family soon realized what had happened: the shopkeeper had been preparing for a snowstorm and had run out of milk. They were relieved that the shopkeeper had already taken care of the problem.

Cindy was happy that she had recognized the problem. Next time, she would know that she shouldn't leave getting milk too late.

Lily and Ben are friends who like to play in the park. They see a big stick on the ground and have an idea. They want to see who can jump over the stick better.

"I can jump higher than you!" Lily says to Ben.

"No, I can jump higher than you!" Ben says to Lily.

They take turns to jump over the stick. They try to jump as high as they can. They are competitive and want to win.

Lily jumps first. She bends her knees and swings her arms. She jumps over the stick and lands on the other side. She smiles and says, "See? I did it!"

Ben jumps next. He bends his knees and swings his arms. He jumps over the stick and lands on the other side. He smiles and says, "See? I did it too!"

They look at each other and can't tell who jumped higher. They decide to jump over the stick again. They jump and jump and jump. They have fun and forget about who is better. They are happy and laugh. They are friends who like to play in the park.

Mama was sad and miserable, she didn't like to leave home. But one day, Papa encouraged her to go with him. He said they would go find a special spear. Mama didn't understand why they needed a spear, but she trusted Papa. 

So they set off. Mama and Papa walked a long way until they got to a big river. On the other side, Papa showed Mama that there was a big tree with a special spear hanging from its branches. Mama was very excited. 

When the two of them crossed the river, Mama was scared, but Papa encouraged her to be brave. Eventually, Mama made it to the other side of the river. Papa handed her the spear, and it was so beautiful. They smiled at each other, and Mama was no longer feeling so miserable.

Once upon a time there was a little girl, who loved to act. One day, she found a gray hive and she wanted to act like a bee. She buzzed and hummed and flew around from flower to flower. She even wore a bee costume with wings made of paper!

Suddenly, a bee appeared and said, "Why do you act like a bee?" The little girl stopped humming and said, "I love to act." The bee smiled and said, "It's good to love to act, but why do you choose to act like a bee?"

The little girl thought long and hard until she realized something. She told the bee, "I like to act like a bee because I can learn from it. Bees build and collect honey, and they help pollinate flowers. I can act kindly like a bee too and help make the world better."

The bee smiled and said, "Very wise, little girl. You understand the importance of being kind." From then on, the little girl always liked to act kindly and help others, just like the bee.

Once upon a time, there were two little birds, Tom and Jerry. Tom was grumpy and Jerry was always cheery. One day, the two birds quarreled over the biggest twig they could find. 

Tom declared, "I think the biggest twig is rightfully mine!" Jerry disagreed and said, "No, it should be mine!" 

This disagreement caused a big storm between the two birds and they both flew away in opposite directions. 

Tom flew towards the exit of the forest while Jerry chose to stay inside. 
Tom then realized that he had gotten lost on the way out, and he was not happy. 

Just then, Jerry found Tom with a clear view of the exit. He smiled, knowing he had outsmarted his grumpy friend. 

Tom and Jerry flew out of the forest together, and although Tom was still grumpy, this time he had a twig in his beak for Jerry. 

The two birds had learned to work together in spite of their quarrels.

Lily and Ben are twins. They like to play with their toys and books. But sometimes they disagree about what to play. Today, they disagree about the comb.

Lily wants to comb her doll's hair. She thinks it is important to make her doll look pretty. She takes the comb from the drawer and says, "This is my comb. I need it for my doll."

Ben wants to comb his car. He thinks it is important to make his car go fast. He sees the comb in Lily's hand and says, "No, this is my comb. I need it for my car."

Lily and Ben start to pull the comb. They both want the comb. They are not happy. They make loud noises.

Mom hears the noises. She comes to the room and sees Lily and Ben. She says, "What is going on? Why are you fighting over the comb?"

Lily and Ben tell Mom what they want to do with the comb. Mom says, "I understand. But you can't both use the comb at the same time. You have to share. Sharing is important. How about you take turns? Lily can comb her doll's hair first, and then Ben can comb his car. Or Ben can comb his car first, and then Lily can comb her doll's hair. What do you think?"

Lily and Ben think about it. They agree to share. They say, "OK, Mom. We will take turns. Thank you for helping us." They hug Mom and smile. They are happy. They play with the comb and their toys and books. They do not disagree anymore.

One day, a little girl named Lisa wanted to take a walk to the park. She got dressed and put on her shoes. She could hardly wait to enter the park and explore.

When Lisa entered the park, she was filled with joy. There were bright colors, pretty flowers, and lots of things for her to do. She ran to the playground and began to play.

But then something strange happened. Lisa looked down and noticed her skin was different. It looked red and her arm was hot. Lisa was very upset.

Luckily, her mom saw what was happening and ran over to comfort her. She grabbed a cold cloth, placed it on Lisa's arm, and said everything would be alright.

Slowly, the skin on Lisa's arm stopped feeling hot and soon returned to its normal color. Lisa smiled, thankful that she was alright. She could continue to explore and play in the park without feeling bad. From that day on, Lisa was always sure to have her mom nearby when she entered the park.

One day, a boy named Tim found a rag in his room. The rag was old and gloomy. Tim thought he could use the rag to clean his toys. So, he started to wipe his toys with the rag.

As Tim was cleaning, his friend Sam came over to play. Sam saw the gloomy rag and asked, "What are you doing with that rag, Tim?" Tim replied, "I am using it to clean my toys, so they are nice and shiny."

Together, Tim and Sam used the rag to clean all the toys. When they were done, the toys looked bright and new. They played with the toys all day long and had lots of fun. The old gloomy rag had helped them have a great day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very excited because it was her birthday. Her mommy and daddy told her they had a surprise for her.

Lily's mommy made a cake that looked like a castle, but it was fake. It was made of paper and had no yummy cake inside. Lily was sad that she couldn't eat the cake. 

But then, her mommy and daddy brought out a real cake with candles on it. Lily blew out the candles and her mommy and daddy fed her a big slice of cake. It was the best birthday ever!

Gina was on a tour with her family. They flew in an airplane, took a boat, then walked through a spicy forest. While they were walking, Gina started to sniffle, then she sneezed. Her family started to laugh, and her brother asked if the spicy smell made her sneeze. She shook her head and said, "No, I just sneezed from the breeze!" They all laughed and kept walking. The spicy air made them all sneeze, but they enjoyed the tour. They eventually made it back home and had some cold water. It was a very fun day!

One day, a girl named Sophie went to the beach with her mum. They gazed at the bright shining sea for a long time, it was beautiful! 

Sophie was having so much fun building sand castles. She made them big and tall. Suddenly, a stupid seagull came and knocked down her castle. Sophie was so mad, she shouted and jumped around.

Mum said it was time to go home. But Sophie wanted to stay! She gazed out at the sea, with its shimmering waves. She wanted to stay and play here forever. 

Mum said they had to go back but promised they could come back another day. Sophie smiled and they walked back, dreaming of their next beach visit.

Once upon a time there was a duck who lived near a school. Every day, the duck heard lots of noise coming from the class.

One day, the duck had had enough! He wanted to be quiet and get some rest so he flew to the school to tell the children to be quiet.

When he got there, he saw the children playing outside and singing. He flew over to them and said, "Quack! Quack! Please stop singing and be quiet."

The children were surprised to see the duck, saw how yellow his feathers were, and stopped singing. They knew that the duck wanted some peace and quiet.

The duck thanked them for being quiet and flew away feeling happy. From then on, the children kept their voices low during class, so that the duck wasn't disturbed. 


The End.

Once upon a time, there was a fit bunny. Every day, the bunny would go for a run. After running, the bunny liked to rest. One day, when the bunny stopped to rest, he spotted a strawberry. It was big and red, and it looked yummy.
The bunny was excited! He hopped over to the strawberry and took a big bite. The strawberry was so sweet and delicious! The bunny ate the whole strawberry.
Afterwards, the bunny felt full and happy. He was even more fit after eating the strawberry! He hopped around and then he found a nice grassy spot to rest. The bunny snuggled into the grass and fell asleep. He had a long, restful nap. 
The bunny woke up feeling happy and refreshed. He hopped away and enjoyed the rest of his day!

Once upon a time, there were two best friends, a boy and a girl. Their names were Joe and Sarah. They both liked to play together and always made each other laugh.

One day, Sarah asked Joe to marry her. Joe was so happy, he said yes right away. They were both so excited, they decided to throw a big party.

Everyone was having a great time until a mysterious cage appeared. Nobody knew where it came from. Joe and Sarah were scared, but they were brave. They decided to open the cage and see what was inside.

Inside, they found two birds. Joe and Sarah explained to the birds that they wanted to get married someday, and said that the birds could come with them if they wanted. And so, the birds flew around Joe and Sarah as they said â€˜I doâ€™.

Everyone cheered and clapped. Joe and Sarah were now married. From that day on, the birds always stayed close by Joe and Sarah, remembering the special day when their new friends got married.

Lily and Ben were friends who liked to play with toys. They had a toy phone that could record their voices. They liked to pretend they were talking to each other or to other people.

One day, they decided to play a prank on Lily's big sister, Mia. They hid the toy phone under Mia's bed and recorded a scary message. They said, "Hello, Mia. We are the monsters under your bed. We are going to get you when you sleep. Boo!"

They giggled and ran away, leaving the toy phone on. They waited for Mia to come home and hear the message. They thought it would be very funny.

But Mia did not come home that day. She had to stay at the hospital because she was sick. Lily and Ben did not know that. They got bored and went to play with other toys.

That night, Lily's mom came to her room and told her the bad news. Mia had a fever and had to stay at the hospital for a long time. Lily felt very sad and scared. She wanted to see her sister and hug her.

She went to her bed and tried to sleep. But then she heard a voice under her bed. It was the toy phone. It said, "Hello, Mia. We are the monsters under your bed. We are going to get you when you sleep. Boo!"

Lily screamed and cried. She thought the monsters were real and they had come for her. She did not remember that it was her and Ben who recorded the message. She called for her mom, but her mom did not hear her. She was too busy talking to the doctor on the phone.

Lily felt very alone and afraid. She wished she had not played the prank on Mia. She wished she had been a humble and kind sister. She wished Mia was there to protect her. But she was not. She had left her alone with the monsters.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Amy. She loved to decorate her house for special occasions. Today was no exception.

Amy and her family were getting ready to celebrate her third birthday. She gathered all the decorations and asked her mum, "How can I decorate?"

Her mum smiled and said, "Why don't you hang a pretty hoop on the wall?"

Amy excitedly ran to get the hoop. She carefully hung it on the wall, and stepped back to admire her work.

There was a small voice coming from the hallway. It was Amy's little brother. He said, "Can I help you decorate, Amy?"

Amy smiled and said, "Yes! You can help me hang the balloons around the hoop and the walls."

So, Amy and her brother set to work. They carefully hung the balloons in the quiet room. Finally, everything was decorated and ready for the big party. 

Amy and her brother hugged and said, "Happy birthday, Amy!"

Once upon a time there was a clumsy boy. His name was Tommy. He loved to touch things.

One day, Tommy was playing in his room when he found a mysterious bottle. He picked it up and examined it closely. It was beautiful and he wanted to take it with him. 

Suddenly, he heard his mum call from the kitchen: "Tommy, come here quickly!"

Tommy ran to the kitchen and tried to hide the bottle behind his back, but his mum noticed it.

"Tommy, what have you got there?" she asked.

Tommy was silent. His mum smiled and said: "Let me see that bottle. You can keep it, but you have to be careful - it's very fragile." 

Tommy was so happy. He gave his mum a big hug and said: "Thank you!"

He was careful and gentle as he touched the bottle and thanked his mum again. From then on, he never stopped being careful and always touched things gently. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big park with lots of trees and flowers. In the park, there was a statue of a yellow duck. The duck was very pretty and all the children loved to play around it.

One day, a big wind came and started to scatter all the leaves and flowers around the park. The children were happy to play with the leaves and run after them. But then, the wind started to get stronger and it started to scatter the toys and balls too.

The children were sad because they didn't want to lose their toys. But then, the wind stopped and they saw that the statue of the yellow duck was still standing strong. They were happy that their favorite statue was safe and sound. From that day on, they made sure to always take care of the statue and never let anything bad happen to it.

Once upon a time, there were two friendly friends named Joe and Joanne. They liked to plan fun adventures together. One day, they had a great plan. They wanted to make a special stitch!

Joe and Joanne gathered up their things and went to Joanne's house. Joanne had all sorts of colorful material and pieces of thread. They picked different pieces and made a plan for the special stitch.

They worked very hard and soon had a plan all worked out. Joanne showed Joe how to use the needle and thread. Joe stitched and stitched until he had made a beautiful stitch! Joanne and Joe were so proud.

Joe and Joanne looked at the pretty stitch and hugged each other. They were so happy with their finished stitchâ€”it was perfect!

The two friendly friends had made the best plan ever and they cherished the special stitch they had made. They knew they would look back on this day, and always smile.

Once there was a small fish. The fish loved to swim all day. The fish had many friends in the water.

One day, the small fish met a big fish. The big fish was sad. The big fish could not find food. The small fish wanted to help.

The small fish swam fast to find food. The small fish found food and gave it to the big fish. The small fish provided food for the big fish. Now, the big fish was happy. They both swam together and became good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Alice. She was three years old and loved to explore. Today, Alice wanted to go for a walk in the park. 

Alice grabbed her coat and she went outside with her puppy, Fluffy. In the park, Alice saw a big, green tree and decided to climb it. 

Alice: "Wow! It looks so easy."

Alice easily climbed up to the top of the tree and found a secret hiding spot. Inside the secret spot was a pack of yummy gum!

Alice: "Oh wow! I can have a yummy gum!"

Alice chewed some gum, but she started to get sleepy. She curled up in the tree and fell asleep. When she woke up, the sun was setting and night had come. 

Alice's puppy, Fluffy, was still waiting for her at the bottom of the tree. They both went home and Alice had a great adventure. She thanked the tree for its easy climb and went to bed. 

Alice was so happy and content with her day that night she had the sweetest sleep.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little dolphin. He lived in the ocean, and he loved to play with his friends. Every day, he swam and listened to the waves crash against the shore. 

But when it was time to sleep, the dolphin went to a special spot. It was a quiet place, where he could be alone and go to sleep. He would close his eyes, and drift away on the waves. 

Soon, the other ocean creatures knew about the dolphin's special spot. Every night, they would come and join him. They would curl up around him, and sleep together until the sun came up. 

The dolphin and his friends were very happy. They loved sleeping together, and dreamed of swimming together when the sun rose. Cuddling up with his friends made the dolphin feel safe and warm. Soon, everyone was sleeping peacefully, and the dolphin had the best dreams ever!

Once upon a time, there was a funny little boy named Tim. Tim loved to laugh and play with his friends. One day, Tim found a camera in his toy box. The camera was very special because it could take brilliant pictures.

Tim took the camera outside to play with his friends. They laughed and played together, taking pictures of each other. The sun was shining, and the sky was blue. The brilliant pictures showed them laughing and having fun.

At the end of the day, Tim and his friends looked at the pictures on the camera. They laughed again, remembering the fun they had. Tim was so happy that he found the brilliant camera. From that day on, he always took it with him to capture the happy moments with his friends.

Once upon a time there was a pale oil that wanted to melt. The oil warmed up and became hot. The oil started to move and it felt like it was running away. The oil was so happy that it started to laugh. Big bubbles began to appear and the oil melted and spread out. Suddenly it was everywhere, like a big hug. The oil was so cheerful that it melted even more and soon it was joining with other oil. Everywhere the oil melted it was full of joy. The oil was so big that it became a bright rainbow of colors. The oil smiled and was so happy that it melted and danced in the sun all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a very loyal dog. His name was Spot. He had a special promise to keep. Every day, Spot would go to the park and mix things up with his best friend, a little girl called Sarah. 

They would mix sand and water together to make a fun sandcastle. They would mix dirt and leaves together to make mud pies. They would mix twigs and rocks together to make an adventure track.

No matter what was mixed, Spot was always there to help Sarah. He was very loyal and made sure no one else ever played with her sand or her mud or her tracks. Every day, Sarah thanked Spot for keeping his promise.

After some time, Spot and Sarah made the best mix of all, a magical potion. They mixed together laughter, happiness, and friendship to make a special potion. The potion was so special, it made Spot and Sarah the best of friends forever.

Once upon a time, there was a huge grass field where all the animals played. Every day, when the sun shone, the animals would perform in the grass.

The highest jumpers were the rabbits. They could jump very high in the air! 
The fastest runners were the dogs. They could race across the grass like the wind! 
The strongest lifters were the bears. They could lift big logs in the air!

The animals had so much fun performing in the huge grass field. They chased each other and laughed a lot. 

In the end, the animals had to go home, but they promised each other to meet again the next day in the huge grass field. 

The end.

The little girl was excited to go on an adventure. Her favorite thing was going to the museum with her family. She always thought it was amazing. 

Today, the little girl was the first to arrive at the museum. She requested to go first to the dinosaur room. She was fascinated by all the different kinds of dinos. She got to learn more about the different excitement of ancient creatures.

Next, the little girl was taken to the art room. She saw beautiful paintings from all around the world. Everywhere she looked there was something new and amazing to explore. The little girl couldn't believe how much there was to see.

Finally, the family wrapped up their visit at the museum. The little girl had a great day and enjoyed all the amazing things she saw. She couldn't wait to request another visit to the museum soon!

Once upon a time, there was a friendly dog named Max. Max liked to play with his toys and run around in the park. One day, Max saw a cat walking by and decided to invite her to play. The cat was happy to join in and they had lots of fun together.

After a while, they got tired and sat down in the grass. It was very quiet and there was a silence all around them. Max and the cat enjoyed the peacefulness and just sat there for a while. Then, they said goodbye and went their separate ways.

Max was happy to have made a new friend and couldn't wait to invite the cat to play again. From that day on, Max and the cat became good friends and would often enjoy the silence of the park together.

Once upon a time, there lived a small boy named Alex. He was curious and liked to explore. One day he decided to march around his house to find something exciting.

He opened the closet door and noticed a delicate little box. He was so intrigued that he knew he had to open it. He slowly opened the box and inside were two beautiful wings. He had never seen wings so delicate before.

Alex was so excited that he could not resist trying on the wings. He put them on and looked in the mirror. Immediately, he felt that he could fly.

He ran around the house shouting, â€œI can fly! I can fly!â€. His mom heard him and came to the room. She said to him, â€œAlex, you can march around the house and have fun, but itâ€™s not safe to fly yet. When youâ€™re old enough, Iâ€™ll teach you to fly properly.â€

Years later, when Alex was old enough, his mom took him to the hills where she taught him how to fly. She let him fly around using his delicate wings and he loved it. He will never forget the day he found the wings in the closet and started to learn how to fly.

Once there was a little girl named Sarah. She loved to play and have fun. One day, Sarah went to the park with her friends. They played tag and bounced on the trampoline for hours. Sarah laughed and had a great time!

After the playtime, Sarah and her friends went for a snack. Sarah felt so happy, she knew she had been a success. She was so proud of herself!

When afternoon came, Sarah was very tired. She had bounced, ran and laughed all day. Her mom came to pick her up and gave Sarah a big hug. She said that Sarah had worked very hard, and it was time to go home and rest. 

As they drove away, Sarah smiled - she had had a wonderful day. And she knew she would have the energy to bounce again tomorrow!

One day, a boy named Tim went to the zoo with his mom. They saw many animals there. They saw a fat elephant, a tall giraffe, and a big lion.

Tim saw a man raise his hand. The man was the zookeeper. The zookeeper said, "Who wants to help me feed the animals?" Tim was excited and said, "Me! Me! I want to help!"

So, Tim and the zookeeper went to the fat elephant. Tim gave the elephant some food. The elephant was very happy. Tim and his mom had a fun day at the zoo. They went home and told dad all about it.

Sammy was very hungry. He wanted something delicious! He went to the kitchen and found a yummy bowl of strawberries. He lifted one of the strawberries with his thumb. He was so happy! His mom came over and asked him what he was doing. He said he wanted to record how delicious the strawberry was. Then, Sammy smiled at his mom and took a big, juicy bite of the strawberry. Yum! It was so delicious. He recorded how tasty it was in his mind and smiled. Then, he enjoyed eating the rest of the strawberries. He wasnâ€™t hungry anymore!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a special lamp that he loved very much. The lamp was very bright and helped Timmy see in the dark. One night, Timmy fell asleep with the lamp on. 

In the middle of the night, Timmy woke up and saw that the lamp was still on. He knew he had to turn it off because it was not wise to waste electricity. Timmy turned off the lamp and went back to sleep. 

The next morning, Timmy's mom was very proud of him for being so wise and turning off the lamp. She gave him a big hug and told him how much she loved him. From that day on, Timmy always remembered to turn off the lamp before he went to sleep.

Once upon a time there was a bossy little girl. Every day she would boss her mom and dad around.

Her parents were tired of it and they decided to punish her. They told her she had to go to the hospital.

The little girl was scared and didn't want to go. But her parents said she had to.

When she got to the hospital, she was surprised. All the doctors and nurses were nice to her. They smiled and gave her toys and candy.

Finally, her parents came to get her. They were sorry they had punished her. But they said it was important to be nice and listen.

The little girl learned her lesson. She hadn't been nice before, but now she was very polite. And she never bossed her parents around again.

Once, there was a girl named Lucy. She was 3 years old. Every day she asked her mom if they could go out to the park. Today, mommy said yes. 

When they got to the park, Lucy saw two friends playing on the swing. "Can I swing too?" asked Lucy.

The two boys lent Lucy the swing so she could play too. She had so much fun!

Then, Lucy wanted to have some fun in the sand. She lent her mom a little bucket and filled it up with sand. But she needed something else too.

"Mommy, can I have some salt?" asked Lucy.

Mommy smiled. She knew that Lucy wanted to make sand castles. She lent Lucy some salt and Lucy carefully sprinkled it on the sand. Suddenly, the sand became so solid that it didn't move.

"Wow, now my sandcastle looks so fragile!" exclaimed Lucy.

Mommy smiled. She was so proud of her daughter.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to dance and sing all day long. One day, Lily's mom told her that they were going to a festival. Lily was so excited! She put on her best dress and became very happy.

When they arrived at the festival, Lily saw lots of people dancing and singing. She saw lots of yummy food too! She ate a big piece of cake and it was so fine. Lily danced and sang with everyone and became very tired.

On the way home, Lily fell asleep in the car. She dreamed of the festival and how much fun she had. When she woke up, she became sad because the festival was over. But she knew that she would go to another festival soon and become happy again. The end.

Sam woke up in the morning. His mommy was making breakfast. Sam was excited. He saw a tray of eggs and bacon on the table. He jumped out of bed and ran over to it. 

"Mommy, can I have a piece of bacon?" Sam asked. 

"Yes, you can!" Mommy said.

Sam took a piece of bacon and started eating it. He was so excited. But then the bacon fell into the glass of milk. Sam looked very sad.

"Oh, no! My bacon is wet!" he said. 

Mommy laughed. She gave Sam a napkin and said, "Let's try this again, okay? I have some fresh bacon here, just for you!"

Sam smiled and grabbed the fresh, dry bacon. He ate it in one bite and said, "Yummy!"

Lily was very happy today. She had a new suit. It was pink and soft and had a big bow. She wanted to show it to her friends at school. She put it on and looked at herself in the mirror. She smiled and said, "I look pretty!"

She ran downstairs and saw her mom and dad. They were also wearing new suits. They were going to a party. They hugged Lily and said, "You look very pretty, Lily. We are proud of you. But we have to go now. Grandma will take care of you."

Lily waved goodbye to her mom and dad. She was a little sad. She wanted to go to the party too. But she knew she had to stay with Grandma. Grandma was nice and fun. She made cookies and read stories. She also had a big dog named Spot. Spot was Lily's friend. He liked to play and cuddle.

Lily and Grandma had a good time. They ate cookies and read stories. They played with Spot and his toys. They sang songs and danced. Lily was happy again. She forgot about the party. She had fun with Grandma and Spot.

But soon it was dark outside. Grandma said, "It's time to sleep, Lily. You had a busy day. You need to rest. Tomorrow you can go to school and show your new suit to your friends."

Lily nodded. She was tired. She hugged Grandma and Spot and said, "Thank you, Grandma. Thank you, Spot. I love you. Good night."

She went to her room and put on her pajamas. She brushed her teeth and climbed into her bed. She closed her eyes and dreamed of her new suit and her friends. She was happy. She slept well.

Once there was a brave knight. He was traveling in a far away land when he saw a volcano. He was very curious, so he decided to explore it. He rode closer, and the ground began to shake. He looked around and saw thick smoke spewing out of the volcano. 

The brave knight was determined to explore it, so he got off his horse and began to climb. He was surprised to see that the volcano looked much bigger up close. He kept climbing, and finally reached the top. 

When he looked inside, his heart sank. He saw bubbling lava rising up and down. But before he could turn around and run, a giant dragon flew out of the volcano. 

The dragon glared at the brave knight. He could feel his courage weakening, but he still tried to fight it. He grabbed his sword, but the dragon just roared and nodded its head. The knight was filled with fear and he ran as fast as he could away from the volcano. He never looked back.

Once upon a time, there was a smart doggy. He loved going on adventures and was always alert. Every morning, he would go outside and look for something new to explore. 

On one bright day, he found something exciting! He found an open window and decided to go inside. He saw a room full of work and he quickly started helping. He thought it was so much fun to move the pen and paper around. 

He was so busy that he lost track of time. By the time he realized it was getting late, his owners were coming home. He heard them so he quickly ran out the way he came. 

That night, he couldn't stop thinking about the room full of work. So the next day he decided to return. He had a happy surprise waiting for him at the window. His owners had left a toy for him with a big hug. He was so delighted and cleverly brought the toy back to his home. 

To this day, the doggy never stops being alert and always looks forward to his next adventure!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to help her mommy in the kitchen. Her mommy always said that cooking together was a fun way to spend time and make healthy meals.

One day, Lily and her mommy were making a yummy salad. They chopped up some lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumbers. Lily's mommy said, "We need something to provide a little extra crunch in our salad."

Lily thought for a moment and said, "I know! We can add some carrots!" Her mommy smiled and said, "That's a great idea, Lily. You're such a good helper in the kitchen." They added the carrots and the salad was delicious.

Later that day, Lily's family came over for dinner. They all sat down to eat the salad that Lily and her mommy had made. Lily's aunt took a bite and said, "Mmm, this is so healthy and delicious. Lily, you're such a good cook!" Lily beamed with pride and felt happy that she could provide a yummy and healthy meal for her family.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little dog named Max. Max loved to play outside and dig in the dirt. One day, Max's owner, a little girl named Lily, noticed that Max's fur was getting very messy and dirty.

"Lily, Max needs a bath," said Lily's mom.

"I don't want to give him a bath," said Lily. "It's too hard."

"I have an idea," said Lily's mom. "Let's tie Max to the tree and use tape to clean his fur."

Lily thought this was a great idea. They tied Max to the tree and used tape to clean his fur. Max was very clean and happy. He wagged his tail and barked happily.

"Thank you, Mom," said Lily. "That was easy and fun!"

Max barked happily in agreement. From that day on, Max was always clean and happy, thanks to Lily and her mom's clever idea.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Meggy. She was only three years old and she loved playing with the equipment from her daddyâ€™s garage.

One day, when her dad was away, Meggy decided to go into the garage. She had to stand on a box to see over the top of the work bench. When she looked inside, she saw all the expensive equipment!

Meggy thought it would be so much fun to play with it for a while. She touched the tools and felt them with her tiny hands. Then she started to pick them up and make noises like she was fixing something.

Just then, her father walked in. Meggy was so embarrassed! He was really upset and shouted at her, telling her never to go into the garage again.

Since then, Meggy has never been allowed back in to the garage. She still looks with hope, but all she can do is stand outside and wish.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was very selfish. She wanted to keep things all to herself and never share with anyone else.

One day, it was hot outside so she decided to get some ice. She went to the store and bought a big bag of ice. She offered to carry the bag for her mom, but she secretly wanted to keep it all to herself.

When she got home, she wanted to put the ice in the freezer so it stayed cold. But the bag was too heavy to lift by herself. She asked her mom for help, and she was able to lift it up and put it in the freezer.

The little girl was happy she could get her ice cold, but she was still very selfish and never offered to help her mom lift the bag of ice.

Once upon a time, there was a brave girl who loved to smile. Her cheeks were always full of joy.

One day, she went to the river to fish. She brought a spear and threw it into the water. But she was too young and foolish, so she did not know how to use it properly.

Her father saw what was happening, and he smiled. He jumped into the water and grabbed the spear. Then he handed it to the girl and showed her how to use it.

The girl listened carefully and smiled even wider. After a few minutes, she had caught two big fish! She was so happy that she couldn't stop smiling.

The father was proud of her too, and he smiled at her with love. From that day onward, she never forgot how to use the spear.

Once upon a time, there was a frog called Freddie. Freddie was a happy frog and he liked to hop around in nature. He always loved the sound of the birds chirping and the water lapping against the rocks. One day, Freddie found something sharp on the ground. He picked it up and discovered it was a shiny rock! He marveled at how beautiful it was and wanted to show his friends.

He made sure to be extra careful with it, as it was very fragile. So, Freddie slowly hopped away, carrying the shiny rock in both hands. Everywhere he went, his friends were amazed by its beauty. They admired how sparkly the rock was and couldn't believe how lucky Freddie was. 

With a smile on his face, Freddie hopped back to nature with the rock. He gently placed it back where he found it and hopped away with a smile. He was glad he'd been extra careful with the fragile rock- after all, nature was a special place that should always be respected.

Once upon a Sunday, Mommy, Daddy and the baby packed the car. They wanted to get organized for their day out. Daddy went to the back of the car and loaded all the bags into the boot. Mommy put the baby in the seat and strapped him in nice and tight. Then Mommy and Daddy got into the car and drove away. 

At the beach, Daddy unloaded the car. He put the bags on the sand and took a big beach blanket from the boot. Mommy helped Daddy and made a cozy spot on the sand. Daddy put the bags into a pile and they were very organized. 

Mommy and Daddy played with the baby in the sand and the water. They built a castle and the baby named it Sunday Castle. He ran around and had so much fun at the beach. 

When the day was done, Daddy went to the car and loaded the bags into the boot again. Mommy put the baby in his seat and strapped him in tight. They drove home and the baby fell asleep in the car. What a wonderful Sunday!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Sue. Sue was jumping up and down in puddles outside. She loved to make a big splash. Suddenly, she saw something on the edge of the puddle. It was a black hook.

"What is this?", Sue asked her mom.

"It's a fishing hook, honey", Mom answered. "We can go fishing with it!"

So Sue and Mom took the black hook and started fishing. They tossed it into the water and splashed around with it. They waited and waited, until Sue suddenly felt something tugging on the black hook.

"Mom, something is pulling the hook!" Sue said excitedly. Then, they both pulled out the black hook. On the end was a big, silver fish!

"We caught a fish!" they said together.

Sue and Mom were so happy and they laughed and hugged each other. Sue loved fishing with her mom and was very excited that she was able to catch her first fish with a black hook.

Once upon a time, there was a big, heavy rock. It was too heavy for anyone to move. One day, a little bird flew by and saw the rock. The bird wanted to play with the rock, but it was too heavy to lift.

The bird felt sad and left the rock alone. But then, a little mouse came along. The mouse saw the rock and wanted to play with it too. The bird warned the mouse that the rock was too heavy to move, but the mouse didn't listen and tried to move it anyway.

The mouse couldn't move the rock, and the bird told the mouse that it should have listened and ignored the rock. From that day on, the little bird and the little mouse played together and ignored the big, heavy rock.

Once upon a time, there was a filthy tank. It had been there for a long time and never been cleaned. One day a little boy decided to visit the tank. He was curious and wanted to know what was inside.
He reached in and pulled out a toy. It was an old toy, but the little boy was excited and it started to repeat something strange. The boy was even more curious and wanted to know what it was saying. He listened carefully.
The little boy was surprised to find out that the toy was actually saying, "Clean the tank!" He knew it was time to start cleaning. He went and got a brush and started scrubbing. He worked hard and soon the tank was no longer filthy. He was proud of his work and put his toy back in the tank.

From then on, every time the little boy visited the tank, the toy would repeat the same message, "Clean the tank!" The boy would smile and repeat the message back to the toy. He always made sure to keep the tank clean.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a mug that he loved to drink milk from every day. One day, Tim's mom gave him a new mug that was very thoughtful because it had a picture of Tim's favorite animal on it.

But Tim had a cold and he kept sneezing all day. He sneezed so hard that he accidentally knocked over his new mug and it broke into pieces. Tim felt very sad because he loved his new mug.

Tim's mom saw how sad he was and gave him a big hug. She told him not to worry and that she would buy him a new mug. Tim felt better and stopped sneezing. He smiled and hugged his mom back.

Once upon a time, there was a helpless pit. It was deep and dark, and no one ever came near it. One day, there was a soft noise and something started to happen. A tiny flower had begun to bloom, right in the darkest corner of the pit. It was the most beautiful thing the pit had ever seen. The flower shone and brought light and happiness to the helpless pit. Everyone was amazed and happy, but the flower didn't stay forever. Soon, the petals began to fall off and the flower disappeared. But the pit was still happy because the flower had made it bloom. 

The End.

Once upon a time, there was an old man. He was very kind and enthusiastic. He loved to play with the kids in the park. He had a trusty old dog who followed him everywhere. 

One day in the park, the old man met a 3 year old boy. He had never been to the park before, and he was feeling a bit scared. He was unsure of what to do.

The old man said, â€œDonâ€™t worry. You can trust me. Letâ€™s have some fun!â€ He took the boyâ€™s hand and they started to play together. They chased the old dog, ran around, and laughed. Soon the boy was feeling no fear and was excited to be in the park.

The old man and the boy became great friends. From that day on, the boy always trusted the old man. He was enthusiastic to come to the park and would always look forward to their adventures together. 

The old man and the boy taught us all an important lesson: no matter how old you are, you can find trust and friendship with others.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a drum. The drum was big and red. Tim thought it was easy to play the drum. He hit the drum with a stick and it made a loud noise. Tim was happy.

Tim wanted to show his friend, Lily. He went to her house and said, "Look at my drum!" Lily liked the drum too. She said, "Can I try?" Tim said, "Yes, it's easy!" Lily hit the drum and it was very loud. They laughed and played the drum together.

Tim and Lily played the drum all day. They did not mention the drum to their moms and dads. They wanted to keep it a secret. But, the drum was too loud. Their moms and dads heard the noise and came to see. They all laughed and played the drum together. It was a fun day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play with her toys. One day, she was playing with her dolls when her mom called her for lunch. Lily was nervous because she didn't want to stop playing.

"Lily, it's time for lunch," said her mom.

"I don't want to stop playing," said Lily.

"You have to surrender your toys for a little while and come eat," said her mom.

Lily didn't want to surrender her toys, but she knew she had to. She put her dolls away and went to eat lunch with her mom. After lunch, Lily went back to playing with her dolls. The result of surrendering her toys was that she got to eat a yummy lunch and then continue playing with her toys.

Once upon a time there was a clever bunny. His name was Jack. He had a special weapon which he used to protect his friends.

One silly day, Jack was out walking in the forest with his friends. Suddenly, they heard a loud noise! What was it? 

"Let me take a look," said Jack bravely. So he bravely grabbed his weapon and ran off to the source of the noise. 

He found a giant monster! It was big and very scary. The monster shouted, "I will get you!" 

But Jack bravely held up his weapon and shouted back, "No, you won't! I will protect my friends!" 

The monster saw that Jack was brave. He knew that he had met his match! So the monster turned and ran away.

Jack had saved the day! His silly weapon had protected his friends from the giant monster. From then on, Jack was a hero.

Lily and Anna were sisters who liked to play together. One day, they found a bottle of perfume in their mom's room. They wanted to smell like mom, so they sprayed the perfume on themselves and their dolls.

"Wow, we smell so pretty!" Lily said.

"Yes, we do!" Anna agreed.

But the perfume was too strong and made them sneeze and cough. Their eyes and noses hurt. They felt sick and dizzy.

"Mom, mom, help!" they cried.

Mom heard them and ran to the room. She saw the perfume bottle and the girls.

"Oh, no, what have you done?" she asked.

"We wanted to smell like you, mom, but the perfume is terrible!" Lily said.

"I'm sorry, mom, we didn't know!" Anna said.

Mom hugged them and said, "It's okay, girls, I know you didn't mean to. But you should never touch things that are not yours, especially things that can be dangerous. Perfume is not for children, it can make you sick. You need to ask me before you use anything in my room, okay?"

"Okay, mom, we're sorry," the girls said.

Mom took them to the bathroom and washed their faces and hands. She gave them some water and medicine. She said, "You need to take a nap now, to feel better. I'll be with you."

She tucked them in their beds and kissed them. She said, "I love you, girls, and I want you to be safe and happy. Remember, you don't need perfume to be pretty. You are beautiful just the way you are."

The girls smiled and said, "We love you, mom. Thank you for taking care of us."

They closed their eyes and fell asleep. They dreamed of sweet things and learned their lesson.

Once upon a time, there were two little boys in the town. One of them was Jack, who was three years old. He went to the dock early every morning with his father. Today, dad had given Jack an important task.

"Jack," said dad, "It's your turn to load up the boat with the fish."

Jack was excited. He grabbed the net and started to load the boat. With each fish, his score improved. 

But suddenly, he heard a loud noise. 

"Oh no," said Jack.

The noise was coming from inside the boat - it was his dad! He had fallen on the fish and was now miserable.

Jack ran over to help. He tried to help his dad but it was too late. Dad had broken his arm and needed to go to the hospital immediately. 

Jack was sad. He had to go home without his dad. His score was low, and his dad was in pain. It was a miserable ending.

Anna and Ben are friends. They go to the same class at school. They like to play and learn together. One day, their teacher tells them they will have a special guest. He is a farmer who will show them some animals.

Anna and Ben are very excited. They love animals. They hope to see a cow, a pig, a sheep, or a horse. They wait for the farmer to come. When he arrives, he has a big truck. He opens the back of the truck and takes out a crate. Inside the crate, there is a small, fluffy, white animal.

"Hello, children," the farmer says. "This is a rabbit. His name is Snowy. He is very soft and gentle. He likes to eat carrots and lettuce. Who wants to pet him?"

All the children raise their hands. They want to touch the rabbit. The farmer smiles and takes out Snowy from the crate. He holds him in his arms and walks around the class. He lets each child stroke Snowy's fur. Snowy is very calm and mild. He does not bite or scratch. He only wiggles his nose and ears.

Anna and Ben are the last ones to pet Snowy. They are very happy. They think Snowy is the cutest animal they have ever seen. They wish they could have a rabbit like him at home.

"Thank you, farmer," Anna says. "Snowy is very nice. Can we give him something to eat?"

"Sure, Anna," the farmer says. "I have some carrots and lettuce in the truck. Do you want to help me get them?"

"Yes, please," Anna says. She looks at Ben and offers him her hand. "Do you want to come with me, Ben?"

Ben nods and takes her hand. They follow the farmer to the truck. They help him carry the carrots and lettuce to the class. They share them with the other children. They feed Snowy and watch him munch and crunch. They laugh and clap. They have a lot of fun. They thank the farmer again for bringing Snowy. They hope to see him again soon.

Lily and Tom were friends who liked to play music. Lily had a drum that she loved to bang with her hands. Tom had a flute that he blew with his mouth. They made a lot of noise, but they had fun.

One day, they went to the park to play music for the birds and the squirrels. They found a nice spot under a big tree and started to play. The birds and the squirrels came to listen and dance. Lily and Tom were happy.

But then, a big dog came running to the park. He saw Lily's drum and thought it was a toy. He ran to Lily and grabbed her drum with his teeth. He ran away with the drum, wagging his tail.

Lily was very sad. She cried and cried. Tom was angry. He shouted at the dog.

"Hey, you bad dog! Give back Lily's drum! That is not your toy! That is her music!"

The dog did not listen. He kept running with the drum. He thought it was fun to make Lily and Tom chase him.

Lily and Tom ran after the dog, but they could not catch him. He was too fast and too strong. He was a mighty dog.

They ran and ran, until they came to a house. The house had a fence and a gate. The dog ran inside the gate and closed it with his paw. He thought he was safe.

But the house was not his house. It was the house of a farmer. The farmer had a lot of animals: cows, pigs, chickens, and a cat. The animals did not like the dog. They did not like his noise and his smell.

The dog saw the animals and wanted to play with them. He dropped the drum and ran to the animals. He barked and jumped and chased them.

The animals were scared and angry. They did not want to play with the dog. They wanted him to go away.

The cow mooed and kicked the dog with her hoof. The pig oinked and bit the dog with his snout. The chicken clucked and pecked the dog with her beak. The cat meowed and scratched the dog with her claws.

The dog was hurt and scared. He wished he had not taken the drum. He wished he had not run to the house. He wished he had listened to Tom.

He ran to the gate and opened it with his paw. He ran out of the house and back to the park. He saw Lily and Tom waiting for him. He saw the drum on the ground.

He felt sorry for what he had done. He went to Lily and Tom and wagged his tail. He licked their faces and gave them the drum.

Lily and Tom were surprised and happy. They forgave the dog and hugged him. They thanked him for giving back the drum.

The dog learned his lesson. He learned that he should not take things that are not his. He learned that he should be nice to other animals. He learned that music is better than toys.

He asked Lily and Tom if he could play music with them. They said yes and smiled. They gave him a flute and taught him how to blow it. They played music together for the birds and the squirrels. They became friends.

The moral of the story is: Do not be greedy and selfish. Be kind and respectful. Share and enjoy music.

Tom and Anna are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big dog. The dog is black and white. It has a long tail and big ears.

"Look, a dog!" Tom says. He likes dogs. He wants to pet the dog.

"Be careful, Tom," Anna says. She is afraid of dogs. She thinks the dog is loud and scary. She does not want to pet the dog.

"I am not afraid," Tom says. He walks to the dog. He says, "Hello, dog. Can I pet you?"

The dog looks at Tom. It wags its tail. It licks Tom's hand. Tom smiles. He pets the dog.

"See, Anna? The dog is nice. He is not loud and scary. He is quiet and friendly. Do you want to pet him too?" Tom asks.

Anna shakes her head. She stays away from the dog. She says, "No, thank you. I do not want to pet him. I do not like dogs."

Tom says, "Come on, Anna. Do not be afraid. I dare you to pet the dog. He will not bite you. He will lick you. It is fun."

Anna thinks. She does not want to be afraid. She wants to be brave. She wants to be Tom's friend. She says, "Okay, Tom. I will pet the dog. But only for a little bit."

Anna walks to the dog. She holds out her hand. The dog sniffs her hand. He wags his tail. He licks her hand. Anna feels the dog's tongue. It is wet and warm. She giggles. She pets the dog.

"Good girl, Anna. You did it. You pet the dog. You are brave. You are my friend," Tom says.

Anna smiles. She says, "Thank you, Tom. You are right. The dog is nice. He is not loud and scary. He is quiet and friendly. He is my friend too."

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Jack. He was very excited because he was at the beach with his mom.

The sun was shining and the sea was very calm. Jack saw a big, blue wave rolling in and asked, "Mom, can I go and play?"

Mama nodded, "Yes, be careful. Have fun!"

Jack hopped on the sand and danced, spinning and twirling around on his toes. He laughed as the wind blew through his hair, like a big hug.

Then, he heard something. Jack turned and saw a pretty, pink kite flying above him. He waved at it and shouted, "Hi!"

The kite spun in circles above Jack's head. He smiled and felt so happy, like he was dancing in the sky.

Jack and the kite played together all afternoon. They spun together, over the sea and the smooth sand. 

"Bye-bye kite," Jack waved as the sun went down and it was time to go home.

The kite waved back, spinning one last time. Then it flew away, taking all of Jack's happy memories with it.

Jimmy was walking home from school. It was dark outside. As he walked, he saw an old house. The windows were dark and it was so quiet. He wanted to see what was inside, so he walked up to the door. He was so scared, his hands were shaking. He knew he shouldn't go inside, but he just had to. He opened the door and stepped inside. He couldn't see anything, it was so dark. Then, he blinked. Suddenly, he saw hundreds of fireflies flying around the house. It was so beautiful! When he blinked again, the fireflies were gone. Jimmy smiled and closed the door. He was no longer scared, he felt happy and excited. He went home, hoping to see the fireflies again one day.

Once upon a time, there was a smart little girl named Lily. She loved to test things out and see how they worked. One day, she decided to test the bathroom sink by turning on the faucet and watching the water flow.

But something went wrong. The water didn't stop flowing and soon the bathroom was filled with water. Lily tried to turn off the faucet, but it was stuck. She didn't know what to do and the water kept rising.

Eventually, the water flooded the whole house and Lily's family had to move away. Lily was very sad that her testing had caused such a big problem. She learned that sometimes it's important to be careful when testing things out.

Once there was a dog named Benny. He liked to eat bones. Benny's mommy always made sure to put a nice and sweet bone out for him.

Benny loved gnawing on the bones. He always chewed them very slowly, savoring each bite. Benny's mommy would watch and sometimes give him an extra pat if he did an especially good job.

One day, Benny found a nice, sweet bone in the park. Immediately, he started to chew on it. He chewed and chewed until it was gone.

Benny's mommy was so proud of him. She put out a special treat for him that night and thanked him for being so brave and strong.

Benny enjoyed his special treat, knowing that he had been so brave and strong enough to find and eat his special sweet bone.

Once there was an old man. He was very kind. He wanted to show kindness to everyone. So he knelt down one evening and made a pretty wish. He wished that everyone in the world will always be happy.

He stayed there for a long time, with his eyes closed and his hands together. Then he stood up and went on his way.

Everyone around him could tell he was a kind old man. They could see the kindness in his eyes and the way he smiled at them.

The next day, when the sun was setting, he knelt down again and made another wish. This time he wished for all the children in the world to be happy and safe.

He stayed there for a few moments before standing up again. He was sure his wishes were coming true. He knew that the power of kindness was strong enough to make his wishes come true.

Once upon a time, there was a big ship. It sailed on the sea and had many rooms for people to sleep in. One day, a little girl named Lily went on the ship with her family. She was very excited to see the ocean.

While on the ship, Lily met a kind lady who was very compassionate. The lady gave Lily a toy compass to play with. Lily loved the compass and showed it to her family. She mentioned how nice the lady was and how much she loved the compass.

As they sailed on the ship, Lily saw many fish and birds. She also saw dolphins jumping out of the water. It was a very fun adventure for Lily and her family. They were happy to have met the compassionate lady and to have sailed on the big ship.

Bob was an impatient boy. He loved to eat. He saw a menu outside a restaurant and he wanted to gain all the delicious food. He opened the door and walked in.

The restaurant was empty. He started to get his food and eat it. He wanted more and more. He ran around the restaurant and was very happy.

Suddenly, two big police officers came in. They saw Bob, and they were not happy. They said, "you cannot take other people's food, that's stealing!" They took Bob home.

Bob was so sad. He learned his lesson and never went back to the restaurant. He had gained nothing. He was very disappointed.

Once upon a time, there was a nut. It was small and round and it rolled around in its tree. But one day, it fell out of the tree and onto the ground. The nut was scared. It did not know what was happening.

Suddenly, it noticed another nut. It had the same size, shape, and color. The first nut was happy and it joined with the other nut. They started to bounce around and have fun.

But then, they noticed something scary. It was a big, scary bug. The two nuts were so scared that they rolled away as quickly as they could. The big bug followed them, but it was too slow and it couldn't catch them.

Finally, the two nuts made it back to their tree. They were so glad and hugged each other. Then, the two nuts went back to their tree and rolled around happily together.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside and explore. One day, he saw a garage that he had never seen before. He wanted to go inside and see what was there. His mom said, "Be careful, Timmy. Don't slip on anything."

Timmy went inside the garage and saw lots of tools and machines. He was so excited to look at everything. But then, he saw a big, red button. He asked his mom what it was for, but she didn't know. Timmy wanted to press it, but his mom said, "No, Timmy. That could be dangerous."

But Timmy didn't listen. He pressed the button and suddenly, the whole garage shook. Timmy tried to run out, but he slipped and fell. The machines in the garage started to make loud noises and smoke filled the air. Timmy's mom rushed to help him, but it was too late. The garage exploded and Timmy was gone forever.

From that day on, Timmy's mom always reminded him to be careful and not to touch things he didn't understand. She knew that sometimes, bad things can happen when we don't listen to the people who care about us.

It was a beautiful day and Little Joe wanted to go for a walk. He quickly put on his shoes and ran outside. 

On the grass, he saw a big hole. Little Joe was curious, so he slowly approached the hole. As soon as he reached it, he noticed something moving inside. 

Little Joe said, â€œHello? Whoâ€™s there?â€

A little voice replied, â€œItâ€™s me. Iâ€™m Mrs. Mouse. Iâ€™m stuck in this hole and I canâ€™t get out.â€

Little Joe was nosy and he wanted to help Mrs. Mouse. He said, â€œIâ€™m going to catch you so you can get free.â€

Mrs. Mouse was very thankful and together she and Little Joe were able to get her out of the hole. Mrs. Mouse was happy to go back home. 

Little Joe was glad he was able to help her. He waved goodbye and went back home with a smile on his face.

Once there was a girl called Jane. She was very shy and always preferred to stay alone. As Jane grew, she wanted to make friends but felt too scared to try. One day, she decided to take a chance.

Jane walked up to the group of children and slowly said, "Hi." The children turned to her in surprise.

"What do you want?" asked the tallest boy.

"I was wondering if I could join you," Jane answered.

The children looked at one another and then smiled. "Sure! We'd love it if you'd play with us," said the same tall boy.

Jane smiled, her face turning red. She was so excited to make friends. They played all sorts of games, even with a thermometer that the tall boy had added. And, before she knew it, Jane had made a brand new group of friends.

Lily and Ben were best friends. They liked to play with toys and draw pictures. One day, they decided to put on a show for their moms and dads. They used a big box as a stage and some old clothes as costumes.

Lily was a princess and Ben was a knight. They acted out a story they made up. The princess was locked in a tower by a mean dragon. The knight had to rescue her with his sword and shield. He also had a secret weapon: a peanut.

The dragon was allergic to peanuts. When the knight threw the peanut at the dragon, the dragon sneezed and ran away. The knight climbed the tower and freed the princess. They hugged and danced happily.

Their moms and dads watched the show and smiled. They were very proud of Lily and Ben. When the show was over, they clapped their hands and cheered. They applauded loudly.

Lily and Ben bowed and thanked their audience. They were very happy. They shared the peanut as a snack. They agreed that it was the best show ever.

Lila and Max like to play pirates. They have a big box with old clothes and hats and swords. They pretend the box is their ship and they sail to find treasure.

One day, they find a map in the box. It has a picture of an island with a big X. Lila says, "Let's go to the island and collect the treasure!"

Max agrees and they put on their pirate outfits. They take the map and some tools and get on their ship. They sing a pirate song as they sail.

Soon, they see the island. It has a beach and a hill and some trees. They land on the beach and look at the map. It shows a path to the hill. They follow the path and find a hole in the ground. The map says the treasure is in the hole.

They use their tools to dig in the hole. It is very deep. They work hard and get dirty. After a while, they see something shiny. They dig more and find a chest. They open the chest and see a lot of jewelry. There are rings and necklaces and bracelets and earrings. They are all gold and silver and have colorful stones.

"Wow!" Lila says. "Look at all the jewelry! We are rich pirates!"

"Yay!" Max says. "We found the treasure! Let's put the jewelry on and show Mom and Dad!"

They put the jewelry on and close the chest. They carry the chest back to their ship. They are very happy and proud. They sail back home and show their parents their treasure. Their parents smile and hug them and tell them they are very clever pirates. Lila and Max smile and say, "Arrr!"

Once there was a fine dancer who was the best dancer ever. She loved to pass her time by dancing. Every time she danced, it made her feel so happy! One day, she was in the park, dancing away. Suddenly, a little 3 year old walked up to her and said, â€œCan I pass with you?â€ she smiled and said, â€œOf course!â€ The little 3 year old was so excited. She started to run and pass around the dancer. Every time the dancer moved, the little one followed. They danced and played until the sun went down. At the end of the day, the little one said, â€œThat was fun!â€ The fine dancer smiled and said, â€œIâ€™m glad you had a good time.â€

Once upon a time there was a cute little girl. Every day she would love to play and sing her favorite song. Her song was so catchy! Every day she would repeat her song over and over again, until it was almost dark. 

One day, the little girl was walking around and singing her song when she met a big mean monster. He was so ugly and he growled at the little girl. He asked her to stop singing her song, but the little girl refused. 

The monster got very angry and he grabbed the little girl. She was so scared that she started to cry. But the monster didn't care, he just held the girl tightly and refused to let her go. 

The little girl never sang her song again. The monster kept her trapped and made sure that she never sang again. So the little girl never shared her cute song with the world again.  This is why you should always be careful who you meet when you are out and about in the world.

One day, Tom and Anna were playing with shapes. They had a box of shapes that they could fit into holes. Tom liked the star shape best. Anna liked the circle shape best. They took turns putting shapes into holes.

Then, Tom saw a big shape on the wall. It was a shadow of a monster. Tom was scared. He dropped the star shape and ran away. He shouted, "Anna, leave! There is a monster!"

Anna looked at the wall. She saw the shadow too. But she was not scared. She saw that the shadow was made by a lamp and a toy. She smiled and said, "Tom, come back! There is no monster. It is just a lamp and a toy. See?"

She moved the lamp and the toy. The shadow changed. It became a flower. She showed Tom the lamp and the toy. Tom came back. He felt silly. He said, "Sorry, Anna. I was scared for nothing. It was not a monster. It was just a lamp and a toy."

Anna hugged Tom and said, "It's okay, Tom. Sometimes we get scared of things we don't understand. But we can always look closer and find out the truth. Then we won't be scared anymore."

They picked up the star and the circle shape. They continued playing with shapes. They had fun.

The moral value of the story is: Don't be afraid of things you don't understand. Look closer and find out the truth.

Once upon a time there was a small girl who was sad. Everywhere she went, the people were so rude! She was feeling very lonely.

One day, when the girl was walking around, she saw an old man sitting on a park bench. She went up to him and asked him why he was so sad. He told her he'd lost his purse and was worried he had no money.

The girl was very kind, so she reached into her pocket and put some money into the old man's purse. She gave him a big hug to comfort him.

The old man was so happy, he smiled and thanked the girl for being so nice. From that day on, the girl made sure she was always nice to people - she never wanted to be as rude as she'd seen other around her.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She went for a walk in the park with her mom. Suddenly, she saw a little boy playing with a pipe. "Mommy, who is he?" asked Lily. "I don't know, let's go introduce ourselves," replied her mom.

"Hi, my name is Lily, what's your name?" asked Lily. "My name is Timmy, nice to meet you," said the little boy. "That's a lovely pipe you have there, can I play with it too?" asked Lily. "Sure, let's play together," said Timmy. They played together and had lots of fun.

After a while, it was time to go home. "Goodbye, Timmy. It was nice to meet you and play with your lovely pipe," said Lily. "Goodbye, Lily. Let's play again soon," said Timmy. Lily and her mom walked home, happy to have made a new friend.

Once upon a time there was a girl, who was brave and strong. She wanted to make a perfect dress, with lots of colourful stitches. But she faced a problem, the dress kept falling apart no matter how many stitches she added. She kept trying to fix it, but it kept coming apart.

But then, one day, the girl had an idea. She took a tiny needle and thread and worked on the dress, carefully and slowly making small, tight stitches. The dress stayed together, no matter how hard she pulled it. The girl was so happy, as her hard work had finally paid off â€“ the dress was now perfect!

The girl knew she had to keep working on the dress, to make sure it stayed strong and perfect. But, no matter how hard she worked, the dress stayed together and resisted coming apart. The girl was so proud of her perfect dress. She knew she had used the perfect stitches.

Once upon a time, there was a big car named Dependable. He had a very important job. Dependable would take a family to the park every day. The family had a mom, dad, and a little girl named Lily. They all had a lot of love for each other.

One day, when they got to the park, they saw a big sign that said, "Fun Race Today!" The family was very excited. They knew that Dependable was very fast and could win the race. So, they decided to join the race.

The race started, and Dependable went very fast. The other cars tried to catch up, but Dependable was too quick. In the end, Dependable won the race! The family was so happy and proud of their car. They knew that their love for each other and their trust in Dependable made them win the race. And from that day on, they had even more fun at the park, knowing that they had the fastest and most dependable car around.

Once upon a time there was a new little bunny. Her name was Chloe and she was very excited to explore the world. 

One day she was hopping in the forest when something big happened! The trees began to shake and the ground rumbled. Chloe didn't know what to do, so she crouched down and covered her ears until the shaking stopped. 

When it was all over, Chloe looked around and saw all of the other animals. They were all looking just as scared as she felt. 

Suddenly, a wise old owl spoke up. "My friends," he said. "We just had an earthquake!"

Everyone looked confused. "What is an earthquake?" Chloe asked.
