Once upon a time, there was a gray bunny. He was hopping around the garden and enjoying the sunshine. He came across a beautiful daisy and decided to include her in his day of fun. They hopped around the garden and played for hours. The daisy laughed and the bunny hopped with joy. They were having a lot of fun together! Then, the bunny had to start hopping back home. He said goodbye to the daisy and promised to include her in his next adventure. The daisy waved goodbye, as the bunny hopped away.

Once upon a time, there was a big doll. She was very pretty, with golden curls and bright buttons for eyes. The doll had many friends, and was always having fun.

One day, the doll was outside playing hide-and-seek with all of her friends. They had been playing for a while when the doll noticed something strange. Her friends had suddenly disappeared!

The doll began to worry. Where had her friends gone? She looked all over, but could not find them. Suddenly, she felt scared and alone.

Then, the doll heard a laugh coming from behind a big tree. There were her friends! They had found a spot to keep playing and forgotten to tell the doll. 

The doll was relieved and excited to join them. She never worried again when playing with her friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to watch videos. Every morning she would put on a pretty dress and find the best video to watch. She enjoyed singing and dancing, and the videos always made her smile.

One day, she found a special video and said, "That looks pretty!" She picked it up and watched it with her dad. As they watched, they laughed and sang together. After they were done, the little girl wanted to watch it again.

But where did the video go? The little girl looked all around her, but couldn't find it. Her dad told her he had put it away so they could watch it again soon.

The little girl waited and waited, but eventually the video returned! She was so excited, and she put on her pretty dress to watch it again. This time, her mom and brother joined in. They watched, sang, and laughed together just like before.

The little girl was so happy. She knew that whenever the video returned, she'd get to watch it again with her family.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Ellie. Everyday, Ellie's mum would remind her to carry a special shield like a big hug. Ellie was happy and proud to have the shield and never forgot to carry it.

One day, Ellie and her mum were walking in the park. Suddenly, rain started to fill the sky. Without her shield, Ellie got very wet and cold. She felt scared and ashamed.

Her mum smiled and reminded her to always carry the shield. She hugged Ellie tight and put the shield around her.

Ellie felt warm and happy again. She felt proud to wear her shield and she never forgot to take it with her ever again.

Once upon a time there were two best friends named Tom and Belle. Tom was a kind and compassionate bear and Belle was an adorable little rabbit. 

Tom and Belle were always playing together. They liked to play hide-and-seek and hopscotch.

One day, Tom and Belle were a bit tired. So, Tom suggested they take a nap. Belle agreed and the two put their heads on a pot and fell asleep.

When they woke up, Belle smiled and said, "That was a great nap, wasn't it Tom?"

Tom smiled back and said, "Yes, it sure was. I felt so refreshed and relaxed."

Tom and Belle enjoyed napping together and stayed friends for a long time. The compassionate bear and the little rabbit were always there for each other.

One day, there were two friends named Abigail and Daniel. They decided they would march together in the park. So, they put on their coats and marched off. At first, everything was fun. They sang songs and marched along the sidewalk. 

Suddenly, Abigail felt a sharp pain in her leg. She stopped and cried out. She was so angry. Daniel tried to help her, but she refused. She had to march on her own. 

Abigail marched slowly, trying to ignore the pain. After a few moments, she felt a bit better. She and Daniel continued to march together, happily singing their favorite song. They had made it through their march, despite the pain.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Jenny. Jenny was three years old and she loved exploring nature. Every day she used to go for a walk in the woods near her house. She used to think about all the wonderful things she saw in nature and how loyal nature was to her.

One day, as she was walking, she spotted a little rabbit in a bush. She was so excited and ran over to try and pet it. The rabbit was scared and hopped away. Jenny thought to herself, "I just have to be a bit more loyal to nature and this bunny will learn to trust me". 

So, Jenny started bringing treats with her on her walks in nature. She would wait very still until the bunny came back, and then she would place the treats nearby. It got to a point where the rabbit was comfortable with Jenny being around and it even came out of the bush to eat the treats from her hands.

Jenny was so proud of herself, she had been really loyal to nature and it had rewarded her with a special friendship. From that day forward, Jenny and the rabbit were the best of friends.

Once upon a time there was a baby named Carl. He wanted to do something special and fun, so he decided to crawl. He started crawling slowly, learning new things with every step. He was feeling brave and confident, and he was determined to reach his goal.

He kept crawling and crawling, until all of a sudden he had a surprise! He had reached his goal - a beautiful, new playground! He explored the playground, finding slides and swings, and lots of exciting things to try out.

He kept exploring until he was tired, but he was very happy. Carl had achieved his goal and had a new place to play, and that made him very proud. The end.

Once upon a time, in a big tree, there was a pretty dove. The dove had a shiny stone. She loved her stone a lot. One day, she thought, "I must keep my stone safe."

The dove flew down to the ground. She found a deep hole. The dove said, "This is a good spot to bury my stone." So, she put the stone in the hole and covered it with dirt. The stone was hidden and safe.

Later, the dove went back to the tree. She told her friend, a little bird, about what she did. The bird said, "That's a great idea! Now your stone is safe and sound." They both felt happy and played together in the tree.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy. His favorite thing to do was to play in the park all day. But one day, a storm came and made it too cold and wet to play.

The little boy was scared when he heard the loud thunder. But soon he noticed the white clouds were moving and the thunder was getting quieter. All the birds were still singing and the sun was shining again.

The little boy felt happy again. He sat in the park and just relaxed while the storm passed. The sun was so warm and the air was so clean.

The little boy knew he had to go home soon, but he didn't want to miss a minute of the beautiful weather. He looked up at the sky and smiled. Relaxing in the park after a storm was the best thing ever.

Once there was a girl named Lucy. She was three years old and loved to play outside. One spring day, she was playing with her toy iron. It made her feel grown up, like a mommy or a daddy. 

"Look, Mommy," she said, wrapping the delicate toy around her wrist.

Her Mommy smiled and said,"That's nice, sweetheart. Let's play pretend. You can be my helper and I'll teach you how to use the real iron." 

Lucy was so excited to learn. She followed her Mommy inside. Everything seemed so big and grown up in the laundry room. Lucy watched carefully as her Mommy showed her how to turn on the iron and use it to press the fabric in the laundry basket.

At the end of the day, Lucy was thrilled with her new grown-up skill. 

"Way to go, Lucy," her Mommy said, tousling her hair. She couldn't help feeling very proud of herself.

And that is how Lucy learned to use an iron.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she saw a bright flower in the garden. It was so pretty that she wanted to pick it. But her mom said, "Lily, promise me you won't pick the flower. It's not good to take things that don't belong to us."

Lily promised her mom that she wouldn't pick the flower. Instead, she decided to measure how tall it was. She went inside and got a ruler. She carefully measured the flower and wrote down the number. 

The next day, when Lily went back to the garden, she saw that the flower was gone. She felt sad because she wanted to see it again. But then she remembered her promise to her mom and felt proud that she didn't take it. She realized that measuring the flower was a good way to remember how beautiful it was without hurting it. From then on, Lily measured all the pretty flowers in the garden and enjoyed watching them grow.

Lily and Ben are playing in the living room. They have a new picture book with many animals. Lily likes the giraffe and Ben likes the lion. They take turns to look at the pages and make noises like the animals.

"Look, Lily, this is a lion. Roar!" Ben says, holding the book.

"Wow, Ben, he is big and yellow. Can I see the giraffe?" Lily asks, reaching for the book.

Ben does not want to share. He pulls the book back. Lily pulls harder. They tug and tug until the book rips in half. They hear a loud tear and see the pages fall to the floor.

"Oh no, we broke the new picture!" Lily cries.

"Mommy, mommy, help!" Ben shouts.

Mommy comes running from the kitchen. She sees the mess and the tears. She is not happy.

"What happened here? Who broke the new picture book?" Mommy asks.

Lily and Ben look at each other. They feel sorry and scared. They do not want to get in trouble.

"We did, mommy. We are sorry. We wanted to see the animals. We did not mean to break it." Lily says.

Mommy sighs. She picks up the pieces and hugs the children.

"I know you did not mean to break it, but you have to be careful with your things. And you have to share and take turns. The picture book was a gift from grandma. She will be sad if she sees it like this." Mommy says.

Lily and Ben nod. They say sorry again. Mommy smiles and wipes their tears.

"It's okay. I will try to fix the picture book with some tape. But next time, be gentle and kind. And maybe we can go to the zoo and see the real animals. How does that sound?" Mommy says.

Lily and Ben cheer up. They hug mommy and say thank you. They promise to be good and share. They are excited to see the zoo. They hope the lion and the giraffe are there.

Anna likes to jog with her dad in the park. She likes to see the trees, the birds and the flowers. Sometimes she sees other people jogging too. They say hello and smile.

One day, Anna sees something shiny in the grass. She stops and picks it up. It is a small fairy. The fairy has wings, a dress and a wand. She is very pretty.

"Hello, little girl," the fairy says. "Thank you for finding me. I was lost and scared."

"Hello, fairy," Anna says. "What is your name?"

"My name is Lily," the fairy says. "I came from the fairy land, but I flew too far and got lost. Can you help me go back?"

Anna nods. She likes to help. She puts Lily in her pocket and runs to her dad. She tells him about the fairy. He is surprised, but he believes her.

"Let's go find the fairy land," he says. "Maybe it is near the big pond. There are many flowers there."

They jog to the pond. They see many colors and smells. They hear a loud sound. It is the sound of bells. They follow the sound and see a big tree. The tree has a door and a sign. The sign says "Fairy Land".

Anna knocks on the door. The door opens. A fairy comes out. She looks like Lily.

"Lily, you are back!" the fairy says. "We were so worried about you. Who are these people?"

"They are my friends," Lily says. "They helped me find my way back. This is Anna and this is her dad. They are very kind."

The fairy smiles. She invites them in. She says they can see the fairy land. Anna and her dad are happy. They jog inside the tree. They see many fairies, animals and toys. They have a lot of fun. They thank Lily and her fairy friends. They say goodbye and jog back to their home. They are very tired, but very happy. They have a new fairy friend.

Once upon a time, there was a sailor. He had a big boat. He loved to sail on the water. The sailor was stubborn. He did not like to ask for help.

One day, the sailor went out to sail. The sky was blue, and the sun was bright. The water was calm. The sailor was happy. He sailed far away from the land.

Soon, dark clouds came. The wind blew hard. The sailor was scared. He did not want to be stubborn anymore. He called for help. A big boat came and saved the sailor. The sailor learned that it is okay to ask for help.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and explore the world around her. One day, she saw an elderly lady struggling to carry her groceries. Lily wanted to help, but she didn't know the way.

Later that day, Lily's mom explained to her that sometimes people need help, especially when they're old. She showed Lily the way to be kind and helpful to others.

The next day, Lily saw the same elderly lady struggling again. This time, Lily knew the way and helped her carry her groceries. The lady was very grateful and thanked Lily for her kindness. 

From that day on, Lily always looked for ways to help others. She learned that being kind and helpful was the right way to be.

Once upon a time there lived a brave leopard in a deep, dark forest. All day long the leopard looked for food, playing and exploring all the nooks and crannies of the forest. One day, the leopard came across another animal, who had become tired and weak. The leopard decided to encourage the animal to persevere and keep going. The animal moved a little but was too weak to get up. The leopard kept encouraging the animal until finally it said, "Thank you. I'm just too tired to continue". Suddenly, a hunter appeared and the leopard was too scared to help the animal anymore. The hunter shot the animal and the leopard fled from the forest never to be seen again.

Once upon a time, there was a nosy cat. Cat liked to find secrets. One day Cat heard a funny noise. Cat looked up to the sky and saw a big balloon. It had an exciting secret inside.

Cat said, â€œI want to know the secret inside!â€ Cat jumped at the balloon but it floated away. Cat followed the balloon through the sky.

Cat said, â€œWhat is the secret?â€

The balloon said, â€œI will disappear and you will never know the secret.â€ And with that, the balloon disappeared into the clouds.

Cat was sad the balloon was gone. But Cat kept looking for new secrets. And Cat was sure that one day Cat would find the secret of the mysterious disappearing balloon.

Once upon a time, there was a jolly mom and her daughter. They lived in a small house near a big farm. The mom loved to feed the animals on the farm every day.

One day, the daughter wanted to help her mom feed the animals. They both went to the farm with big smiles. They fed the cows, the pigs, and the chickens. The animals were happy to see them.

But then, a big storm came. The wind blew, the rain fell, and the mom and daughter got very wet. They tried to run back to their small house, but they couldn't see where they were going. The mom and daughter got lost and couldn't find their way home. They were very sad and scared.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and read books. One day, her family went on a trip to the beach. When they got to their hotel room, Lily helped her mommy unpack the suitcases. 

That night, Lily had a dream about a magical castle. It was very big and had lots of rooms. The walls were painted with bright colors and the floors were made of shiny marble. The castle was owned by a rich queen who wore a beautiful crown on her head.

When Lily woke up, she told her mommy about her dream. Her mommy smiled and said, "Maybe one day you will visit a castle like that and meet a rich queen!" Lily was excited and couldn't wait to see what adventures awaited her in the future.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her toys and going on adventures. One day, she went to the park with her mom and saw a mysterious box.

"What's in the box, Mommy?" Lily asked.

"I don't know, let's open it and find out," her mom replied.

They opened the box and inside was a toy elephant. Lily picked it up and said, "Wow, this elephant is heavy! How much does it weigh?"

"It weighs about five pounds," her mom answered.

Lily was amazed. She had never heard of the word "weigh" before. She looked at the elephant and noticed that it had a tag that said "Price: zero". She asked her mom what that meant and her mom explained that it meant the elephant didn't cost any money.

Lily was so happy to have a new toy and couldn't wait to play with it. She hugged the elephant and said, "I love you, mysterious elephant!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her friends. One day, Lily and her friends were playing near a big field. Suddenly, they heard a loud horn sound.

Lily asked her friend, "What's that loud noise?"

Her friend replied, "It's a truck. The driver is letting us know he's coming."

Lily thought the sound was scary, but her friend said, "Don't worry, the driver is dependable. He always drives safely."

Lily felt better and continued playing with her friends. They had so much fun that they forgot about the loud horn sound. From that day on, Lily knew that she could always ask her friend for help when she felt scared.

Lily and Tom were playing in the park. They found a big bow on the ground. It was red and shiny. Lily wanted to play with it. She said, "This is my bow. I can shoot arrows with it."

Tom wanted to play with it too. He said, "No, this is my bow. I can shoot arrows better than you."

They both pulled the bow. They started to fight. They shouted and pushed each other. They were very angry.

A man saw them fighting. He was pale and had a beard. He said, "Stop fighting, children. That is not your bow. That is my bow. I lost it here yesterday. I need it for my work. I am an archer."

Lily and Tom stopped fighting. They felt sorry. They said, "We are sorry, sir. We did not know it was your bow. We just wanted to play with it. It is very pretty."

The man smiled. He said, "It is okay, children. I forgive you. Do you want to see how I shoot arrows with it?"

Lily and Tom nodded. They said, "Yes, please. That would be fun."

The man took them to a target. He showed them how to hold the bow and aim. He shot an arrow. It hit the bullseye. Lily and Tom clapped. They said, "Wow, you are very good, sir. Can we try too?"

The man said, "Sure, but be careful. The bow is strong and the arrows are sharp. You need to listen to me and follow the rules."

Lily and Tom listened to the man. They took turns to shoot arrows. They had fun. They learned a new skill. They thanked the man. They said, "Thank you, sir. You are very kind. We are sorry for fighting. We will share and play nicely from now on."

The man said, "You are welcome, children. I am glad you learned your lesson. You are very brave and smart. Now, go and enjoy the park. And remember, do not fight over things that are not yours."

Lily and Tom said, "We will, sir. Goodbye."

They waved to the man. They ran to the swings. They played happily. They did not fight anymore. They were friends.

Once upon a time, a big elephant was walking in the jungle. The elephant was very hungry and was looking for something yummy to eat. Suddenly, he saw a banana tree and went to eat some bananas. 

After the elephant ate the bananas, he felt happy and full. Then, he saw a little boy and said, "Thank you for letting me eat your bananas." The little boy smiled and said, "You're welcome, Mr. Elephant."

The elephant continued to walk through the jungle, feeling happy and satisfied. He saw some other animals and said hello to them. The animals were happy to see the friendly elephant and they played together. The end.

One day, a brown ship sailed up to the dock. A little boy wanted to gain a ride on it. He asked his mom if he could. She said, "Yes!"

The ship had a big, shiny brown sail. The boy was so excited. He held tightly onto the rail and watched the waves rolling by.

The ship moved faster and faster. The wind blew into the sail, and it took them further away from the dock.

The boy was having so much fun on the journey. He waved to people on the shore and watched the birds flying around.

At last, the ship made it to their destination. The boy felt proud that he had gained an adventure on the brown ship!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and run around outside. But one day, her mom told her she had to study for a test at school. Lily didn't want to study because it wasn't easy for her.

Instead, she decided to play with her toys and forgot all about studying. The next day, she went to school and took the test. But she didn't do well because she didn't study. Her teacher was disappointed and gave her a mop to clean the classroom as a punishment.

Lily realized that studying was important and promised to do better next time. She cleaned the classroom with the mop and thought about how she could make studying easier for herself. From then on, she made sure to study every day and never forgot the importance of it.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Mark. He was full of energy and liked to play silly games everyday. One day, he found a piece of rope on the ground. He decided to make a waist for his teddy bear.

"Hey, Teddy, do you want a waist?" asked Mark.

His teddy couldn't answer, so Mark said, "Yes, you can have one, silly Teddy".

Mark started tying the rope around Teddy's middle and the teddy started to look like he had a waist. Mark then got some markers to decorate the waist, and when he was done his teddy was very proud of his new waist.

Marks laughed and said, "You look silly, Teddy, but it's the best waist ever!"

From then on, Mark and his teddy played all sorts of silly games together with their colourful waists.

Once upon a time, there was a big empty bus. It had no people inside. On the bus, the driver stopped counting. He had been counting all day long.

The driver wanted someone to ride the bus. He wanted someone to listen to him count. All day long, he looked outside to see if anyone was passing by.

One day, he saw a little girl walking by. She was a small 3 year old. The driver asked her if she wanted to ride the bus. The girl was excited. She said â€œYes!â€

So, the driver and the girl got on the bus. The driver started counting and the girl started laughing. She listened to the driver count all the way down the road. It was the best ride ever! The girl never wanted it to end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was different from the other kids. He had a special power. He could save people when they were in trouble.

One day, Tim heard a loud noise. It was a big wake from a boat. He saw a little girl in the water. She was scared and needed help. Tim jumped into the water and swam to her. He said, "Don't worry, I will save you!"

Tim grabbed the little girl's hand and pulled her to the shore. The little girl was so happy that Tim saved her. She said, "Thank you for saving me!" Tim smiled and said, "You're welcome! I'm glad I could help."

From that day on, Tim and the little girl became best friends. They played together every day. Tim was happy to be different because he could save people and make new friends.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He liked to wear a big, dark hat. The hat was his favorite thing to wear. Tim wore the hat everywhere he went.

One day, Tim found a pencil on the ground. The pencil was small and yellow. Tim liked the pencil a lot. He put the pencil in his hat and took it with him.

Tim drew pictures with the pencil. He drew a sun, a tree, and a cat. Tim was very happy with his new pencil. He wore his dark hat and drew pictures every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy. He liked playing with his friends in the park. One day, the little boy was having fun playing games. He was kicking a ball around with his friends. Suddenly, he kicked the ball too hard, and it flew away.

The little boy shouted, "Oh no! Where is my ball?" His friend said, "Don't worry. I'll help you find it!" 

So, the two of them searched for the ball. Eventually, they found it caught in a tree. The little boy said, "Help me get it down!" But his friend shook her head. She said, "I can't reach it. You'll need to go get it yourself." 

The little boy put on his cap, and he climbed up the tree carefully. He was almost there when he slipped and fell back down. He was a bit hurt, and he started to cry. His friend ran over and said, "Don't worry, I have an idea!" 

She took off her cap and put it on the end of the stick. Then, she carefully lifted it up to the ball. The little boy grabbed the ball and the cap, and he climbed down the tree. The little boy and his friend were very happy that they got the ball back. They hugged each other and said, "Yay!"

Once upon a time a little girl named Lisa was playing in her garden. She saw a snake in her garden and it made her feel afraid. Lisa asked her dad what to do.

Her dad said he would help her. "I will take the snake away," he said. Lisa asked if he could take the snake to the lake.

He agreed. Dad put the snake into a box and drove to the lake. Lisa and her dad put the snake in the lake.

The snake began to swim around in the water. It was so happy to be free. Lisa smiled and felt much better.

The snake swished its tail and said â€œThank you.â€ Lisa felt happy and glad that the snake was no longer miserable.

Once upon a time there was a girl called Sarah. She liked to jog outside in the sunshine. Sarah enjoyed jogging slowly and gently.

One day, it was cloudy and looked like it might rain. Sarah didn't want to get wet, so she decided to stay inside. Suddenly, there was a big flash of lightning. It was so bright that it lit up the sky!

Sarah was scared, but then she heard a gentle sound coming from outside. She looked out of the window and saw something miraculous.

It was a giant cloud that was jogging around the sky! It was very gentle and seemed to be jogging at a slow and peaceful pace. Sarah smiled and waved at the cloud as it jogged away.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play together. One day, they go to the lake with their moms. The lake is big and blue. It has fish and ducks.

Anna and Ben see a boat. The boat is red and white. It has a sail and a wheel. They want to ride the boat. They ask their moms.

"Can we ride the boat, please?" Anna says.

"Can we, can we?" Ben says.

Their moms look at the boat. They look at Anna and Ben. They nod.

"Okay, you can ride the boat. But be careful and stay close," Anna's mom says.

"Listen to the man who drives the boat. He is dependable. He knows the lake well," Ben's mom says.

Anna and Ben are happy. They run to the boat. They put on life jackets. They climb on the boat. The man who drives the boat smiles. He starts the boat. The boat moves on the lake.

Anna and Ben sit on the boat. They look at the water. They look at the sky. They see clouds and birds. They feel the wind and the sun. They are having fun.

"Look, a duck!" Anna points.

"Quack, quack!" Ben says.

They laugh. They wave to the duck. The duck swims away.

"Let's play a game," Anna says.

"What game?" Ben asks.

"Who can see more things on the lake. The one who sees more things wins," Anna says.

"Okay, let's play. I go first. I see a fish," Ben says.

"I see a flower," Anna says.

"I see a rock," Ben says.

"I see a leaf," Anna says.

They take turns. They see many things on the lake. They count them. They are both good at the game. They are both smart.

"Who wins?" Ben asks.

"I don't know. We see the same things," Anna says.

"Maybe we both win," Ben says.

"Maybe we do," Anna says.

They smile. They hug. They are both happy. They are both winners. They are both friends.

Once upon a time there was a tiger. He was very big and independent.

One day he went out for a walk in the forest. He was hoping to find some adventure. Suddenly he saw something moving behind a tree. He slowly went up to it.

When he got there, he saw a little rabbit. The rabbit was sitting all alone, looking very sad. The tiger asked him why he was so sad and the bunny said, "I cannot find my way home."

The tiger was very kind and he offered to help the bunny so he could get back home. The tiger guided the bunny through the forest, until they got to his house. 

The bunny thanked the tiger for his help and hugged him. The bunny's family was very happy to see him and they invited the tiger to stay for dinner.

The tiger happily accepted and they all shared a nice dinner together. The tiger was very happy he could help the bunny. He was so glad he was independent and could help others.

The end.

Once there was a little girl named Sarah. She wanted to wear her mama's shoes. She put on one shoe, but it did not fit. "It's too small," said Sarah. She felt ashamed.

Mama told her not to worry. "Sarah, let's try the other shoe," Mama said. Together, Sarah and Mama tried on the other shoe, but it didn't fit either. Mama gave her a hug. "It's okay, Sarah. Some things don't fit," said Mama.

Sarah was sad. She wanted the shoes to fit, but it was too late. She had already tried both shoes.

Suddenly, Mama had an idea. She had a great big bucket of water. "Sarah, try the shoe in the water," said Mama. Sarah dipped one of the shoes into the water and it fit perfectly! She was so happy!

"See, Sarah," said Mama with a smile, "Sometimes things fit in water." Sarah smiled with joy and hugged Mama. She was no longer ashamed.

Once upon a time there was a princess called Emily who loved to watch cartoons. One day, Emily was feeling a bit sad and she wished for a friend to join her. Suddenly, a cheerful cartoon bunny appeared in front of her with an invitation to join him on an adventure. 

The bunny hopped away and Emily followed him until they reached a deep, dark cave. The bunny said he had to rescue his friends who were stuck in the cave, so Emily agreed to help him. With Emily as his sidekick, the bunny hopped into the cave. 

The two of them were very brave and managed to rescue all of the bunnies! When they emerged from the cave, Emily was happy to see her new friends were safe. The bunnies thanked Emily for rescuing them, and the group enjoyed a cheerful picnic together. 

The bunny invited Emily to join them more often and they went on many other adventures. Emily and her new cartoon friends were always happy and had lots of fun!

Joey was playing in the garden one day, when he noticed something strange. His neighbour, Maggie, had a special box. It was shaking and rattling, as if it had something inside.

Joey approached Maggie and asked, "What's inside the box, Maggie?".

Maggie smiled, and said, "It's a secret, Joey! I'm not allowed to tell anyone".

Joey was feeling a bit stubborn, so he followed Maggie around, asking her over and over again to tell him the secret.

Finally, Maggie had had enough. She opened the box, and said, "Look inside, Joey, it's a beehive! They sting, so you mustn't go near them!"

Joey was amazed. He watched the bees buzzing around in the box and thanked Maggie for letting him see her secret.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to the beach with her mommy and daddy. One day, they went to the beach and Lily saw a mighty wave coming towards her. She got scared and ran to her mommy.

"Mommy, mommy, look at the big wave!" said Lily.

"It's okay, sweetie. Waves are fun. Let's go splash in the water!" said her mommy.

Lily and her mommy went into the water and started splashing around. They laughed and had so much fun. Lily loved the beach and didn't want to leave. But eventually, it was time to go home. As they were leaving, Lily said, "Mommy, can we come back to the beach and splash in the waves again?"

"Of course, we can come back anytime you want!" said her mommy.

And with that, Lily was happy and excited to come back to the beach and play in the waves again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his uncle. His uncle was very funny and always made Timmy laugh. One day, Timmy and his uncle went outside to play. Timmy saw a pretty butterfly and tried to grab it, but it flew away. His uncle told him not to worry and that there were many more butterflies to see. Suddenly, the sky became very dark, and Timmy was scared. But his uncle turned on a light and everything became bright again. Timmy was happy and hugged his uncle. They continued to play and have fun together.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim loved to ride the bus to school every day. The bus was big and yellow and took him to school.

One day, Tim's mom told him that the bus was going to improve. Tim didn't know what that meant, but he was excited to find out. The next day, when Tim got on the bus, he saw that it was different. It was new and shiny and had more seats.

Tim was happy because he had more space to sit and play with his friends. The bus driver also told Tim that the bus was now running on a regular schedule, which meant it would always come at the same time every day.

From that day on, Tim loved riding the bus even more. He was happy that it had improved and was now a regular part of his day.

Ben and Lily were brother and sister. They liked to play in the backyard with their toys. But they did not like to share. They always fought over who got the best toy.

One day, Ben found a big red truck in the backyard. He wanted to play with it. He grabbed it and ran away from Lily. Lily saw him and got mad. She wanted the truck too. She ran after him and shouted.

"Give me the truck, Ben! It is my turn!" Lily said.

"No, it is mine! I found it first!" Ben said.

They both pulled the truck hard. They were stubborn. They did not listen to each other. They did not see the big hole in the backyard. They fell into the hole with the truck. They got hurt and dirty. They cried and screamed.

Mom and Dad heard them and came to the backyard. They saw Ben and Lily in the hole with the truck. They were angry and sad. They helped them out of the hole and took them inside. They cleaned their wounds and clothes. They took away the truck and put it in the closet. They said Ben and Lily could not play with it anymore. They said they had to learn to share and be nice.

Ben and Lily hated the hole. They hated the truck. They hated each other. They had a bad day. They wished they had shared and been nice.

Once upon a time, there was a big, brown cow named Betsy. Betsy had a big horn on her head that she used to scratch her itchy spots. One day, Betsy was walking in the field and saw a little boy named Timmy. 

Timmy was very curious and asked Betsy, "What's that on your head?" 

"It's my horn," replied Betsy. 

Timmy asked, "Can I touch it?" 

Betsy said, "Sure, but be careful. It's sharp and might bite you." 

Timmy touched the horn and said, "Ouch! That hurt!" 

Betsy felt bad and said, "I'm sorry. I didn't mean to hurt you. I was ignorant and didn't think about how sharp my horn is." 

Timmy forgave Betsy and they became friends. From that day on, Betsy was more careful with her horn and Timmy learned to be cautious around animals with horns.

Once upon a time, there was a bell. It was round and made of shiny metal. It was so thick that it was hard to move.

One day, a boy was playing in the snow. It was so cold that everything was freezing. Suddenly, he heard a sound. It was coming from the bell!

The boy decided to take the bell to his house. When he did, he saw a tiny bird inside! The bird had been cold, so it had frozen.

The boy was happy when the bird thawed and flew away. He was even happier that the bell was now free to make its happy sound!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a sweet sister named Daisy. They loved to play together and have fun. One day, they decided to go to the park to play on the swings and slide.

When they got to the park, Lily saw a big truck. She asked her sister, "What is that big truck doing?" Daisy replied, "It's here to load some things." They watched as the truck filled up with big boxes.

Suddenly, one of the boxes fell off the truck and landed on Daisy. She was hurt very badly and had to go to the hospital. Lily felt very sad and wished she could take back what happened. She learned that sometimes accidents happen and it's important to be careful.

Sara liked to work with her toys. She had a lot of toys, like dolls, cars, blocks and books. She liked to make stories with them and play pretend. She was very good at work.

One day, her mom said she had to go to a meeting. A meeting was when people talked about things for a long time. Sara did not like meetings. They were boring and took mom away from her.

"Can I come with you to the meeting, mom?" Sara asked.

"No, sweetie, you can't. The meeting is for grown-ups only. You have to stay with dad and play with your toys. I will be back soon, I promise." Mom said.

Sara was upset. She did not want to stay with dad. She wanted to go with mom. She did not want to play with her toys. She wanted to work with mom.

She started to cry and scream. She threw her toys on the floor. She did not listen to dad when he tried to calm her down.

"Sara, stop that. You are making a mess. Mom will be back soon. Why don't you work on a nice picture for her? She will love it." Dad said.

Sara did not want to work on a picture. She wanted to work on a meeting. She did not care if mom loved it. She was angry and sad.

She kept crying and screaming until mom came back. Mom saw the mess and heard the noise. She was not happy.

"Sara, what happened? Why are you so upset? Why did you make such a mess?" Mom asked.

Sara ran to mom and hugged her. She stopped crying and said:

"I'm sorry, mom. I wanted to go with you to the meeting. I wanted to work with you. I missed you. I love you."

Mom hugged her back and said:

"I'm sorry, too, Sara. I know you wanted to go with me, but the meeting was not for you. It was not fun. It was hard and boring. I missed you, too. I love you."

Mom and Sara cleaned up the mess together. Dad helped them. They worked as a team. Sara felt better. She was happy to have mom back. She decided to work on a picture for her anyway. She used her favorite colors and drew a big heart. She gave it to mom and said:

"This is for you, mom. It is a work of art. It is a thank you for coming back."

Mom smiled and said:

"Thank you, Sara. It is a work of art. It is a thank you for being my daughter."

They hugged and kissed. They were happy. They had a good day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing outside and making new friends. One day, she met a boy named Jack. Jack was very helpful and always said nice things to Lily. They became good friends and played together every day.

One day, they saw a big pile of dust in the park. Lily wanted to play in it, but Jack said it was not safe. He said that dust can make us sick and we should stay away from it. Lily was sad, but she knew Jack was right.

Lily learned that it is important to listen to our helpful friends and stay away from things that can harm us. She was grateful to have a friend like Jack who always looked out for her. From that day on, Lily always remembered what Jack had said and made sure to stay safe.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Josh and Beth. Josh found a flute and he was extremely happy. He asked Beth to join him and they started to play the flute together.

Josh asked Beth 'What number shall we play?' Together they counted 1,2,3 and started to play the flute. They had so much fun!

Suddenly, Josh's mom came into the room and saw the flute. She said 'Uh-oh, this flute looks familiar. Have you taken it from the living room?'

Josh and Beth became very quiet. Josh looked down and felt guilty. He knew he had taken the flute from the living room. He admitted it and said 'Sorry mommy'. 

Josh's mom gave him a hug and said 'It's ok. It's important to always tell the truth. I forgive you. Now please put the flute back.'

Josh and Beth put the flute back in the living room and felt better. They promised each other to always be honest and never take things without asking. 

The End

Lily liked to eat. She liked to eat apples, bananas, cheese, and bread. She liked to eat with her mom and dad at the table. Sometimes, she liked to eat with her doll, too. She gave her doll a small plate and a spoon.

One day, Lily wanted to eat a cookie. She saw a cookie jar on the kitchen counter. She climbed on a chair and reached for the jar. But the jar was too heavy. It fell on the floor and broke. Cookies and glass were everywhere. Lily was scared and sad.

Mom heard the noise and came to the kitchen. She saw Lily and the mess. She was not happy. She said, "Lily, what did you do? You could have hurt yourself. You should not touch the cookie jar. It is not for you."

Lily started to cry. She said, "I'm sorry, Mom. I wanted a cookie. I was hungry. I didn't mean to break the jar."

Mom hugged Lily and said, "It's okay, Lily. I'm glad you are not hurt. But you have to ask me before you eat a cookie. Cookies are not good for you all the time. They are only for sometimes. And you have to be careful with the jar. It is not a toy. It is glass. Glass can cut you."

Lily nodded and said, "I understand, Mom. I'm sorry. Can I help you clean up?"

Mom smiled and said, "Yes, you can. But first, let me change your blouse. It is dirty with cookie crumbs and glass. We don't want you to get hurt."

Mom took Lily to her room and gave her a new blouse. It was pink and soft. Lily liked it. She said, "Thank you, Mom. I love you."

Mom said, "I love you, too, Lily. Now, let's go back to the kitchen and clean up. Then, we can have some fruit for a snack. How does that sound?"

Lily said, "That sounds good, Mom. I like fruit. Fruit is yummy and healthy."

Mom and Lily went back to the kitchen and cleaned up the mess. They threw away the cookies and the glass. They swept the floor and wiped the counter. Then, they washed their hands and sat at the table. Mom gave Lily a bowl of fruit. It had apples, bananas, grapes, and strawberries. Lily ate the fruit and smiled. She said, "This is a good snack, Mom. Thank you."

Mom said, "You're welcome, Lily. I'm proud of you for helping me clean up. You are a good girl."

Lily and Mom ate their fruit and talked. They were happy and peaceful. They forgot about the cookie jar. They only remembered their love.

Freddy was always excited to go to school. He loved the icy feeling of the playground, and could never wait to find out what was written on the blackboard.

But this time, things were different. Freddy felt scared. He didn't know why, but he couldn't stop the feeling.

He started to walk in but something felt wrong. Suddenly, he heard a loud scream. A little girl was crying and pointing at the blackboard. Freddy looked to see what was wrong and realised that the blackboard was covered in name. All the names of the children who had suffered. Freddy felt a chill. He felt so scared.

But his teacher walked up to him and gave him a big hug. She told him it was okay. She said that he didn't need to suffer like the children on the blackboard, and even though it was icy outside they would all be safe.

Freddy felt a little bit better. He smiled, and he realised he wasnâ€™t scared to go to school after all.

Ben and Lily were playing in the park with their mom. They liked to slide, swing and run on the grass. They saw a big dog with brown fur and a long tail. The dog was friendly and wagged his tail. He came to Ben and Lily and licked their faces.

"Hello, doggy!" Ben said. He petted the dog's head and ears. "You are soft and warm."

"Can we hug him, mom?" Lily asked. She loved animals and wanted to cuddle the dog.

"Yes, you can, but be gentle," mom said. She smiled and watched her children hug the dog. The dog seemed to like it too. He made a happy sound in his throat.

Then they heard a deep voice calling the dog's name. It was the dog's owner, a man with a hat and a beard. He came to the park and saw Ben and Lily with his dog.

"Hi, there. I see you met Rex. He's a good boy, isn't he?" the man said.

"Yes, he is. We like him. He's friendly and soft," Ben said.

"We hugged him. He licked us," Lily said.

The man laughed and thanked Ben and Lily for being nice to his dog. He said they could play with Rex anytime they wanted. He put a leash on Rex and said goodbye.

"Bye, Rex. Bye, man," Ben and Lily said. They waved and watched them leave.

"Did you have fun, kids?" mom asked.

"Yes, mom. We had fun. We made a new friend," Ben and Lily said. They hugged mom and told her about Rex. Mom hugged them back and said she was proud of them. They walked home together, happy and tired.

Once upon a time, there was a fun factory full of happy workers. They all worked very hard every day to make lots of things for other people.

One day, one of the factory workers wanted to be more independent. She wanted to do her own work and have her own ideas. So, she smiled and shrugged. With determination, she walked right out of the factory and started her own business.

Even though it was difficult to be independent, she kept at it. Slowly, the other workers began to realize what she had done. They clapped and cheered her on.

Soon, the worker had a very successful business. She was so happy. She had managed to create something special, all on her own.

Once upon a time there was a pretty fly. It was orange and had big wings. The sun was shining and the fly was happy.

The fly went buzzing around, looking for food. Suddenly he noticed a bright yellow flower. It had lots of yummy nectar!

He flew over to the flower and started drinking the nectar. It was so sweet and delicious! As he drank, he closed his eyes and blinked in content.

Suddenly, he heard a voice. It was a bee! The bee said: "Hi there, fly! What are you doing here? This flower is mine!"

The fly flew away in a hurry. He was feeling a bit scared. But then he saw something even prettier - a rainbow up in the sky. It was so big and colourful! He just had to go and look closer. 

He flew up to the rainbow and sat on a pot of gold. He blinked a few times in amazement. Then he smiled and said: "This is the prettiest place I have ever seen!"

Once upon a time there was a boy who liked to play outside. One day, he saw something in the sky. It was a flag, waving in the wind.

The boy wanted to get a closer look, so he ran to it. On it, he found a letter. 

"What's this?" he said, picking it up.

Just then, a voice called out, "Be careful! That's a dangerous letter!" It was his mom. 

The boy was curious. "What's it say?" he asked.

"It's a message from someone telling us to be careful," his mom explained. 

The boy was excited. He asked, "Can we mail it back to the person who sent it?" 

His mom smiled. "Yes, we can mail it to let them know that we are safe." 

So the boy and his mom mailed the letter back, and the boy learned about the importance of being careful. He was happy that he could help spread the message of safety using his own flag.

Anna and Ben are playing with their toys in the living room. Anna has a doll and Ben has a car. They are having fun making noises and moving their toys around.

"Look, my doll can dance!" Anna says, spinning her doll on the floor.

"My car can go fast!" Ben says, zooming his car across the carpet.

They play for a while, until they see a big box on the table. It is a present from their grandma. They run to the box and try to open it.

"What is inside?" Anna asks, pulling at the ribbon.

"Maybe it is a cake!" Ben says, poking at the paper.

They rip off the paper and open the box. Inside, they find a colorful top. It has stripes and stars and a long string. They take it out and look at it.

"A top!" Anna says, smiling.

"How do we play with it?" Ben asks, holding the string.

They see a note from their grandma. It says:

"Dear Anna and Ben,

I hope you like this top. It is a special toy that can spin and make music. To play with it, you have to wind the string around the top, then pull it hard and let it go. It will spin on the floor and make a nice sound. It is a healthy toy, because it makes you move and laugh. Have fun with it!

Love, Grandma"

Anna and Ben read the note and follow the instructions. They wind the string around the top, then pull it hard and let it go. The top spins on the floor and makes a nice sound. It looks like a rainbow.

"Wow, it is so pretty!" Anna says, clapping her hands.

"It is so cool!" Ben says, jumping up and down.

They take turns spinning the top and watching it. They laugh and cheer. They are happy with their present. They thank their grandma and hug each other. They play with the top until it is time for dinner.

Tom and Lily were twins who liked to play games. They were very competitive and always wanted to win. One day, they played a game of hide and seek in the house. Tom was the seeker and Lily was the hider.

Lily ran to the kitchen and saw the freezer. She thought it was a good place to hide. She opened the door and climbed inside. She closed the door and waited for Tom to find her. She felt cold, but she did not want to give up.

Tom looked for Lily in every room. He could not find her. He started to worry. He called her name, but she did not answer. He went to the kitchen and saw the freezer. He heard a faint sound from inside. He opened the door and saw Lily shivering and blue.

"Lily, what are you doing in there?" he asked. "You could have frozen!"

"I wanted to win the game," Lily said. "I thought you would not find me here."

Tom felt sorry for Lily. He helped her out of the freezer and gave her a hug. He wrapped her in a blanket and brought her to the sofa. He made her some hot chocolate and gave her a cookie.

"I'm sorry, Tom," Lily said. "I was silly. I should not have hidden in the freezer. It was dangerous and not fun."

"It's okay, Lily," Tom said. "I'm sorry, too. I should not have made the game so competitive. It was not fair and not kind. We should play for fun, not for winning."

They smiled at each other and drank their hot chocolate. They decided to play a different game, one that was safe and fun. They learned to be more careful and more friendly. They bowed to each other and said, "You are a good twin."

The boy was feeling brave and decided to explore his bedroom. He saw many objects that made him feel both powerful and scared. He examined everything he found, but it didn't last long. Suddenly, he heard a loud, powerful roar coming from his closet. He stopped and shivered. He slowly opened the closet door and saw a giant bear inside, examining him carefully. The boy was too afraid to move, his heart pounding. He knew this was a bad ending. The bear stepped forward and chased him out of the bedroom, never to go back in again.

Once upon a time there was a baby who had two legs. They were colorful like a rainbow. One day, the baby was playing in the garden and running around when he fell. He was sad because his leg had hurt when he fell.

He started to cry until his mommy came over to help him. She picked him up and hugged him tight. He felt better and stopped crying.

Mommy then took him inside and put a bandage on his leg. She told him to be careful and said, "Be sure to look where you are walking next time!" This made the baby smile.

His mommy also made him a new colorful toy to play with. The toy cheered him up, and he was no longer sad. He thanked his mommy and they hugged again.

The baby now always looks where he's going when he's playing in the garden. He's learned that it's important to be careful so he doesn't fall again.

Once upon a time there was a pretty green bird. Its wings were like a beautiful rainbow in the sky. The bird liked to zip around the world and explore different places.

One day the bird found a big green tree. It was the most beautiful tree in the world! The leaves were so big and the branches were strong. The bird began to zip around the branches and sang a beautiful song. 

The bird looked so happy! Soon, other animals began to come. There were tiny squirrels, lots of butterflies and even some bright yellow birds! They all liked to zip around with the green bird.

Then, one day, the green bird found a shiny green tree above him. He flew up and perched on the highest branch. He looked down and saw the animals below having fun. He zipped around and flew down to the ground. 

The green bird said goodbye to his friends and flew away. He was so happy - it was the most pretty day ever!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she saw an ugly butterfly flying around her garden. It had brown wings and spots on its body. 

Lily didn't like the butterfly because it looked strange. She tried to catch it with her hands, but it flew away. So, she decided to kick a ball instead. She kicked it high in the sky and it flew like a bird. 

Suddenly, the butterfly landed on the ball and Lily saw it up close. She realized that even though it was different, it was still beautiful in its own way. From then on, Lily never thought of the butterfly as ugly again. She learned to appreciate all the different things in the world.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play with toys. One day, they find a big box in the park. The box has a picture of a yacht on it.

"Wow, look at this!" Anna says. "It is a yacht. A big boat that can go on the water."

"Can we open it?" Ben asks. "Maybe we can play with it."

Anna nods. She and Ben open the box. Inside, they see a yacht. But it is not a regular yacht. It is a toy yacht. It is made of plastic and has wheels.

"Wow, this is cool!" Ben says. "But how can we play with it? It cannot go on the water."

Anna thinks. She has an idea. She points to the slide in the park.

"Let's take it to the slide!" she says. "We can pretend that the slide is the water. We can make the yacht go down the slide and say 'whee!'"

Ben likes the idea. He and Anna take the yacht to the slide. They put it on the top and push it down. The yacht slides down fast and makes a noise.

"Whee!" Anna and Ben say. "This is fun!"

They play with the yacht on the slide for a long time. They are happy. They have a new toy and a new game.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to the ice cream truck and received a cone with her favorite flavor, chocolate. She was so happy and ate it quickly.

Suddenly, the sky turned gloomy and it started to rain. Lily didn't like the rain because it made her wet and she couldn't play outside. She said to her mom, "Mommy, I don't like the rain. It's gloomy outside."

Her mom replied, "Don't worry, Lily. We can play inside and have fun. Maybe we can make some cookies together." Lily smiled and said, "Yay! I love cookies. Thank you, Mommy." And they spent the rest of the day baking and playing together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine with her friends. One day, Lily's friend Emma came over to play. Emma was a bit bossy and always wanted to be in charge.

Lily and Emma decided to play a game of tag. Emma was "it" and chased after Lily. As Lily ran away, she accidentally touched a prickly bush and got a scratch on her arm. She cried out in pain.

Emma saw that Lily was hurt and stopped the game. She apologized for being bossy and offered to help clean the scratch. Lily was grateful for her friend's kindness and forgave her for being bossy earlier.

From that day on, Lily and Emma played together happily, taking turns being the boss and making sure to be careful not to touch any prickly bushes.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a good boy, but sometimes he would scream. He would scream when he was sad, and he would scream when he was mad. One day, Tim found a smooth rock. He liked the rock very much, so he took it to his secret chamber in his room.

In the chamber, Tim would play with his toys and the smooth rock. But one day, his friend, Lily, came to play with him. When Tim showed her the smooth rock, Lily wanted to play with it too. Tim did not want to share the rock, so he screamed at Lily. Lily was sad and left Tim's house.

Tim felt bad for making Lily sad. He thought about what he did and decided to share the smooth rock with her. The next day, Tim went to Lily's house and gave her the rock. They played together and had lots of fun. Tim learned that sharing is good and it makes others happy.

Once upon a time, there was a bee. The bee liked to fly around and collect nectar from flowers. One day, the bee saw a flower that looked very interesting. The bee flew over to the flower and started to collect nectar. 

But then, another bee came along and wanted to collect nectar from the same flower. The two bees started to quarrel and buzzed loudly at each other. They both wanted the nectar from the interesting flower. 

The quarrel between the two bees got louder and louder. Suddenly, a bird swooped down and caught one of the bees in its beak. The other bee flew away quickly, feeling sad and scared. From then on, the bee learned to share the flowers and never quarreled with other bees again.

Anna and Ben liked to play in the park. They liked to run, jump, slide and swing. They liked to see the birds, the flowers and the clouds. They had a lot of fun.

One day, it was very hot and sunny. Anna and Ben did not bring any water or hats. They felt thirsty and tired. They looked for some shade, but they could not find any. All the trees were very small and had no leaves. All the benches were in the sun. They wished they had listened to their mom, who told them to bring water and hats.

They saw a big tent in the corner of the park. It looked cool and dark inside. They ran to the tent and went in. They hoped to find some water and some shade. But they did not find what they wanted. They found a lot of scary things. They found a snake, a spider, a bat and a skull. They screamed and ran out of the tent. They were very scared.

They ran to their mom, who was sitting on a wide blanket. She hugged them and gave them some water and some hats. She told them that the tent was for a Halloween party. She told them that the snake, the spider, the bat and the skull were not real. They were just toys. She told them that they should not go into places they did not know. They should always ask before they enter.

Anna and Ben felt sorry. They regretted going into the tent. They learned their lesson. They said sorry to their mom and thanked her for the water and the hats. They decided to play on the wide blanket, under the shade of an umbrella. They felt safe and happy. They still liked to play in the park, but they also liked to listen to their mom.

One day, Jimmy was bored. He had nothing to do, until he saw his mom's hanger. He had an idea to pretend the hanger was a telephone. He picked up the hanger and said into it, "Hello? His mom said with a smile, "That sounds like a lot of fun!"

Once there was a boy named Jake. He was three years old. Jake wanted to go to the river and have some fun.

Even when the harsh sea storms came, the whale and the little fish stayed together. They knew that no matter what, they would always care for each other.

Once there was a little girl. She liked playing at the beach. One day she and her mom went to the beach together. When they got there, the girl saw a playful tide. She wanted to go and play in it. 

The playful tide was very special. The girl wanted to belong to the cheerful tide. She walked towards it and the tide seemed to accept her. She enjoyed playing with it.

Maddie was deaf, so she couldn't hear very well. But she had a new game to play, and it made her so excited. She was going to play a matching game. Once upon a time there was a bald man. He lived by the sea and every morning he stood on the beach, watching the sun rise and listening to the waves. 

One day he saw something special. A big white bird flew over the sea and hovered above the man. The man was amazed! He wanted to talk to the bird so he whispered to it. 

The bird heard him and flew lower. It flew around the man's head and looked into his eyes. The man smiled. He waved goodbye to the bird as it flew away. 

The man never forgot his special day. Every morning he went to the beach and whispered to the sky. Maybe the bird would visit him again...

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, her mommy asked her to go to the grocery store to buy some milk. Lily was very excited to go on her own.

Lily felt ashamed and said sorry to her mommy. She promised to never forget again. From that day on, Lily always remembered to get the groceries her mommy asked for.

Joe loved visiting his grandma. She was so creative! Every time he visited, she had some new craft to do, or a delicious treat to share.

When Joe came to visit his Grandma the next time, he gave her the picture and gave her a hug. She loved it and was so proud of his creative work!

Jack was an ordinary little boy. He loved to climb. Every day, he would find something to climb on - a tree, a fence, or even the sofa.

After a while, Jack decided to climb back onto the mattress. It was nice and comfy. He snuggled up and soon fell into a deep sleep. 

When he woke up, Jack still had a big smile on his face. He remembered all the fun he had climbing onto his mattress. He knew he would have to do it again soon!

Once upon a time, there was an original robot. He wanted to stand up for himself, so he decided to fight. He was brave and strong, but the other robots were bigger and mean. They kept pushing him, but he wouldn't give up. He kept fighting until finally, the other robots backed away. Everyone was so proud of the robot for standing up for himself! Everyone cheered and clapped as he walked away. He was the bravest robot ever! He will always be an original.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Pete and Sally. One day, Pete thought he could make a special treat for Sally. So, he took some junk and put on the table. He made the junk look red with special paint.

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and a daughter. The daughter was only three years old and she liked to play outside. Every day, the mommy would worry about her daughter because she loved her so much.

One day, the mommy was worried when her daughter did not come home after playing outside. She was very anxious and scared. She started to look for her daughter.
